T44 same-face zero-crossing gluing — proof draft

Date: 2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer package. This closes one specified transfer branch relative to the imported Q4 perfect-endpoint classification; it does not claim the full T44_5 or T15 target.

Claim

Let F be an arbitrary matching of K(Q5) with precisely four holes, all of one parity. Let x,y be two prescribed holes. Suppose some coordinate cut Q5=A∪B has all four holes in A and no required edge of F crossing the cut. Then there is a cycle on exactly Q5⧵{x,y} containing every edge of F and adding only short edges.

The original required edges may be long or same-parity. No shortness assumption is imposed on FA or FB.

Status

PROVABLE AS STATED, relative to the explicitly imported finite Q4 perfect-endpoint classification and the positive path certificates checked below. Independent review of this new proof package is requested.

The dedicated verifier completed with PASS: 311850 matching records, 2486610 explicit positive paths, and all 216 low-endpoint rows passed. The endpoint-count histogram is {3:180,4:36,5:10,6:1040,7:5036,8:305548}.

Notation and dependencies

Identify both coordinate faces with the same Q4, so corresponding vertices differ by the deleted coordinate. Write v¯ for the corresponding vertex in the other face. The map v↦v¯ preserves Q4 distances; as a Q5 map it reverses global parity.

For a perfect matching P of K(Q4) and a root r, let G(P,r) be the set of opposite-parity endpoints of Hamilton paths starting at r, containing all of P and adding only short edges.

Imported input: Q4_PERFECT_ENDPOINT_ABUNDANCE.md proves that |G(P,r)|≥4. Its complete bad-endpoint classification, in q4_perfect_endpoint_abundance_check.json, has 4708 exceptional perfect matchings at root 0, with their exact bad odd endpoint sets. Every nonexceptional matching has at most one bad odd endpoint.

This proof uses two finite statements:

  1. The exceptional bad sets contain none of the endpoint triples in Section 1 below.
  2. The 30 normalized T44 inputs have complete positive path witnesses satisfying the endpoint alternative in Section 2 below.

The dedicated independent checker is verify_t44_sameface_path_gluing.py; it imports no producer or older checker. It relies on the separate proof of exhaustiveness of the perfect-endpoint exceptional universe, rather than assuming the 4708 JSON rows alone establish that exhaustiveness.

1. Endpoint hitting triples

Let ei,ej,ek be three distinct coordinate unit vectors of Q4. For every perfect matching P, each of the sets

{ei,ej,ek},{ei,ej,ei⊕ej⊕ek}

intersects G(P,0).

There are four triples of the first form and twelve of the second. The checker generates all sixteen directly. None is contained in any of the 4708 exact exceptional bad sets. A nonexceptional matching has at most one bad endpoint, so it cannot contain any three-element set of bad endpoints either. This proves the assertion for every perfect matching, using the imported classification. Translation through a root r gives the corresponding statement for G(P,r).

2. Q4 T44 positive path cover

Let L be a matching of K(Q4) whose four holes x,y,b,t all have one parity, where x,y are to be omitted. Normalize by translating x to 0 and permuting coordinates so y=p∈{3,15}. All four holes are then even. Order the included holes so b<t.

For each p, the included pair ranges over (62)=15 choices. For each such hole set, the other twelve vertices have 11!!=10395 perfect matchings. Thus the thirty files q4_t44_path_abundance_p_b_t.bin cover all normalized inputs.

Every row consists of sixteen mate bytes, one path-count byte, and that many explicit 14-vertex paths. Each listed path starts at b, ends at a different odd vertex, visits exactly Q4⧵{0,p}, contains L, and has only short edges outside L.

Let S be the set of endpoints appearing in the positive witnesses for a row. The checked alternative is

|S|≥5orS⊕b contains one of the sixteen triples in Section 1.

Here S⊕b={s⊕b:s∈S} normalizes the path root to 0. The checker validates all positive paths, all mate involutions, exact hole sets, distinct endpoint witnesses, and bijective recursive matching-rank coverage of 0,…,10394 in each file. No claim that the listed endpoints are all possible endpoints is necessary: positive witnesses and their endpoint lower sets suffice.

There are only 216 rows with at most four listed endpoints. Their translated endpoint sets have thirteen possible values. Each contains one of the sixteen hitting triples. The checker also checks directly that none of those thirteen endpoint sets is contained in any of the 4708 exceptional bad sets. This direct comparison is redundant but provides a second implementation of the finite intersection step.

3. Q4 path compatibility consequence

For any L as in Section 2 and any perfect matching P on another copy of Q4 identified vertex-for-vertex with the first, there is a common endpoint q such that:

  • the first copy has a path from b to q on exactly its fourteen nonomitted vertices, extending L with short new edges;
  • the second copy has a Hamilton path from b to q, extending P with short new edges.

To prove this, take the positive-witness endpoint set S from Section 2. If |S|≥5, then |G(P,b)|≥4 and both are subsets of the same eight opposite-parity vertices, so S∩G(P,b)≠∅. If S⊕b contains a hitting triple, Section 1 again gives a member of S∩G(P,b). Choose such a member q and the two paths that witness its membership. Since q is opposite in parity to b, the endpoints are distinct.

The normalization is a proof device only: translate and permute both copies by the same Q4 automorphism, apply the conclusion, then undo that automorphism. The actual matching P remains an arbitrary complete-graph perfect matching under this automorphism.

4. Q5 gluing proof

Since F has no crossing edge, FA has exactly the four original holes and FB is a perfect matching on B. Normalize the two faces as in Section 2, applying the same identification to both.

By Section 3 choose an A path RA from the included hole b to q on exactly A⧵{x,y}, and a B Hamilton path RB from b¯ to q¯. Add the two short cube edges

bb¯,qq¯.

The A and B paths have disjoint supports, and their two pairs of endpoints are distinct. Their union with these two edges is one cycle: start at b, traverse RA to q, cross to q¯, traverse RB backwards to b¯, and cross back to b. It contains fourteen A vertices and sixteen B vertices, exactly Q5⧵{x,y}. Every internal required edge belongs to its corresponding path, and there are no original crossing edges to restore. Every added edge is either a short path edge or one of the two displayed short bridges. This proves the claim. ◻

Consequence and limits

Together with the positive-crossing same-face lemma in T15_ANALYTIC_NOTES.md, this closes the T44_5 branch in which all four holes lie in a common coordinate face, regardless of crossing count. In particular it handles the previously exceptional same-face orbit with avoided pair {0,3} and included pair {5,9} in Q5.

It does not supply a coordinate face for hole geometries that have none, and it does not resolve the remaining T44_5 geometric orbits. The original T44_5 and T15 statements are unchanged. No remaining R8-covered input is claimed closed by this file.

Reproduction and open risks

Run:

python research\six_directions\verify_t44_sameface_path_gluing.py

The output is t44_sameface_path_gluing_verification.json, including all thirty file hashes, complete record/path counts, low endpoint sets, the sixteen hitting triples, and imported-classification hash.

The main external proof dependency is the correctness and complete scope of Q4_PERFECT_ENDPOINT_ABUNDANCE.md. This file explicitly uses its exceptional-set classification, not merely its two endpoint-count bounds. An independent reviewer should check this dependency as well as the new path verifier and the two-bridge gluing.

Full Q5 endpoints add the ten-hole row (4,5)

2026-11-01. Conditional application; fresh independent review pending.

Use the accepted uniform transfer with a covered target v, five holes of each parity, free root u=0, and independent remaining holes Z∪W. Suppose the target face A contains all four vertices of Z and all five vertices of W. Then (a,b)=(4,5) and no bridge source is consumed.

If u∈A, pair the crossing ports and use r=u. If u∉A, the original short internal matching in A has one more even port than odd ports, so choose an even port as r and pair the others. In both cases the A completion has exactly five holes of each parity with free root r. The full balanced-hole Q5 endpoint theorem, conditional on accepted A10 assembly, gives a Hamilton r--v path. This is exactly the even-consumption branch with s=0 of the uniform transfer; only the previously limited local endpoint input is extended to ten holes.

The B hole counts after tagging and transfer are (0,0); there are no conflicts to suppress or marked holes to omit. Apply the arbitrary perfect-matching cycle theorem on B. Expand transferred paths and delete the tag to obtain the required Hamilton u--v path containing the original short matching. If the original crossing set is empty, use the already imported five-direction endpoint theorem as before.

ten_covered_full_q5_endpoint_filter.py scans the accepted 54222 residual records and stores a real cut witness for each record with this row. There are 10/30/30 at targets 1/7/31, so 70 new geometries, leaving 54152 before any new T63 application. All 70 belong to the separate T63 candidate residual; thus they are disjoint from that route's 12916 new records. The exact intersection residual after both accepted routes would be 12910/12696/15630, total 41236.

The producer writes exact remaining bytes and SHA-256 pins. A fresh checker must independently replay the row witnesses and residual sets. Neither numerical subtraction nor a producer report alone accepts the combined coverage. Complete ten-hole and P6 remain open.

Ten-hole covered targets from a marked six-hole split input

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate. Independent acceptance pending.

Claim and status

Relative to the complete Q5 T63 split theorem specified below, the accepted 54222 remaining ten-hole covered-target geometries have 12916 additional uniformly positive geometries. The remaining set has size 41306. This is a conditional application, not a complete ten-hole or P6 proof, and not an assertion that those 41306 inputs are negative.

Exact imported statement

Let L be an arbitrary matching of the complete graph on a five-cube, with exactly six holes H, all of one parity. Let U⊂H have size three. Suppose some coordinate splits (H,U) into counts (2,1) and (4,2). The required imported theorem gives a single cycle on Q5⧵U containing L, with all other edges short, for every such L, including those with zero matching edges across that cut.

The proposed full split proof uses Q4 N14 and Q4 T44 for a nonempty crossing matching. For zero crossing it uses witnessed optional-edge unions plus a complete finite exceptional gluing domain. This import must receive its own independent acceptance before the application below can be counted as closed.

Reduction to that import

Use the accepted uniform transfer in HIGHER_HOLE_UNIFIED_TRANSFER.md. The original Q6 matching is short with 27 edges; its free even root is u=0, and the odd target v is covered. Write the remaining holes as even Z, |Z|=4, and odd W, |W|=5. The accepted input domain already has Z∪W independent. Let A be the coordinate face containing v, and B the other face; put a=|Z∩A|, b=|W∩A|.

For (a,b)=(4,2), choose any three vertices S⊂Z∩A. The A completion has balanced four holes, so its prescribed endpoint input is already proved. The B matching after the audited tagged transfer and simultaneous suppression has hole counts (0,6), and must omit exactly the three odd mirrors U=S―. Its six holes are precisely (W∩B)∪U.

For (a,b)=(1,5), choose three vertices S⊂(W∩A)⧵{u―}. There are at least four eligible vertices, because v is covered and hence is not in W. Again the A completion has balanced four holes. The B matching has hole counts (6,0) and must omit exactly the three even mirrors U=S―. Its six holes are precisely (Z∩B)∪U.

All these are actual distinct holes: the independence reduction excludes an original hole at a bridge mirror, a free source excludes a crossing matching port there, and the odd-consumption choice excludes u. The B matching may have long edges; the proposed split theorem explicitly allows them. Its marked geometry depends only on the holes, cut and chosen S, not on the arbitrary completion matching in A.

Whenever an internal coordinate of B has the marked (2,1)/(4,2) split, apply the imported theorem to this actual B input. Expanding the suppressed paths and deleting the tagged uv edge gives a Hamilton u--v path preserving every original matching edge. The expansion and degree accounting are exactly those of the accepted uniform transfer, with no additional restrictions on the original matching. If the original Q6 cut has no matching crossing, its already imported five-direction endpoint theorem applies directly instead.

Complete conditional coverage calculation

ten_covered_t63_complete_split_profile.py reads only the three frozen residual files accepted by Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json. It tests every one of the six outer cuts, every eligible three-subset S for the two rows above, and the marked internal split counts. It records an actual witness for each newly covered record and preserves all other records byte for byte in separate output files.

These are hole-geometry counts. Each successful row proves the result for every realizing original matching, not just one matching sample. Independent review must reconstruct the exact residual domain and each actual marked split witness before these numbers enter the main ledger.

Remaining obligations

The complete split theorem and this application require independent acceptance. Complete ten-hole covered targets, the complete higher Q6 layers, and full P6 remain open.

TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_A8_TRANSFER.md — Ten-hole covered targets using the accepted partial A8 and K8 inputs

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：Q5_A8_CONSEQUENCES_REVIEW.json, TEN_COVERED_Q5_ENDPOINT_REVIEW.json, TEN_HOLE_COVERED_PARTIAL_REVIEW.json。

Ten-hole covered targets using the accepted partial A8 and K8 inputs

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Proposed sufficient classes; independent review pending. This is not full ten-hole P6.

Domain and imports

Let M be any short 27-edge matching of Q6, u a free root, and v a covered target of opposite parity. Normalize u=0. Its other even holes Z have size4, and its odd holes W size5. If Z-W has a short edge, add it and apply full eight-hole P6; assume henceforth that Z union W is independent.

Use the notation A,B,a,b,delta,c of HIGHER_HOLE_UNIFIED_TRANSFER.md. The target v is in A. For c=0 the imported five-direction theorem applies. The accepted inputs are the complete eight-hole theorem, the accepted uniform transfer and its original eight ten-hole rows, the 24 complete marked T15 cores and full T15 split case, Q5 K8 from Q5_K8_REVIEW, and the partial A8 results accepted in A8_PARTIAL_REVIEW and A8_DELTA4_FIRST_ORBIT_REVIEW. No complete A8 is imported.

Call a marked Q5 geometry (minority set L of size3, majority set J of size5, omitted hole y in J) admissible if either of these conditions holds:

  1. a coordinate face containing y has majority-minus-minority count 1,2,3;
  2. a coordinate face containing y has all five majority holes and one minority.

In the applications below L and J minus y are nonadjacent, as they come from the original independent Z,W. The two audited partial A8 theorems therefore provide the required 31-cycle for every arbitrary matching on the complement of each admissible marked geometry.

Local endpoint conversion

Suppose F is any matching of K(Q5) with four holes of each parity, r is an even hole, and y is a covered odd vertex. Write h=F(y) and form F'=F-yh+hr. Its holes are the old holes minus r plus y. If this marked 3:5 geometry, omitting y, is admissible, partial A8 gives its 31-cycle. Delete hr and append the original edge hy at h. This gives a Hamilton r-y path preserving F with short new edges. This works for every h and does not require knowing the mate h from the hole geometry.

Six additional cut rules

All coordinates in a local admissibility test are the five coordinates other than the original Q6 cut. All parities below are global parities.

  • (a,b)=(0,1): use the uniform no-bridge transfer. A needs the accepted balanced-two-hole endpoint theorem; B has four holes of each parity, after the tagged closure consumes the root if necessary. Apply K8.
  • (1,1): let z be the unique Z hole in A and let y be its mirror in B. Use one even-hole bridge. A needs the two-hole endpoint theorem. The B hole geometry is minority Z intersect B (three vertices), majority (W intersect B) union {y} (five vertices), omitted y. This cut succeeds whenever that actual geometry is admissible.
  • (0,2): choose w in W intersect A with mirror y different from u. At least one choice exists. Use one odd-hole bridge. The B geometry has minority W intersect B, majority (Z intersect B) union {y}, omitted y. Its admissibility suffices.
  • (3,4): use no bridges. The A completed matching has balanced eight holes. In the local endpoint conversion, the root is removed and v added, leaving minority Z intersect A and majority (W intersect A) union {v}. If this geometry omitting v is admissible, the required A path exists; B needs only its already accepted balanced-two-hole cycle theorem.
  • (4,4): choose z in Z intersect A as the even bridge source. The A endpoint conversion has minority (Z intersect A) minus {z}, majority (W intersect A) union {v}, omitted v. Its admissibility suffices. B has exactly two odd holes, one the bridge mirror; use N14 avoiding it.
  • (3,5): choose w in W intersect A whose mirror differs from u. The A endpoint conversion has minority Z intersect A, majority ((W intersect A) minus {w}) union {v}, omitted v. Its admissibility suffices. B has two even holes; N14 omits the bridge mirror.

These are complete statements for every matching realizing each eligible geometry, not just for a sampled matching. The choices of z,w and a local admissibility cut depend only on the original marked hole geometry.

Endpoint and forest bookkeeping

For the first three rows, the accepted uniform transfer applies directly; only its precise B input is replaced by the new accepted theorem.

For the last three rows, repeat its completion D and bridge construction. If delta=1, the A root r is u. If delta=0 and there is no even bridge, it is an even crossing port, which exists by the port imbalance. If delta=0 in row (4,4), it is the chosen even bridge source z. In all three cases the completed A matching has four holes of each parity, and removing r and adding v leaves exactly the geometry displayed above. This equality does not depend on the chosen artificial D or crossing port.

The covered global target v stays covered in the completed A matching: an internal original edge covers it, or it is an odd crossing port paired by D. It cannot be the even root, nor an original free bridge source. Thus the local endpoint conversion applies. Once the A path is supplied, all remaining steps of the uniform transfer are unchanged: remove D, attach original crossings and the optional single bridge, join the global endpoints by a tagged edge, compress the forest and its bridge conflict, apply the stated B theorem, expand, and remove the tag. The root/target degrees, preservation of every original matching edge, and shortness of all surviving new edges follow from that already audited bookkeeping.

Exact finite coverage task

The independent census should enumerate all Z of four nonzero even Q6 vertices, and all W of five odd vertices nonadjacent to Z, for normalized covered target v=1,7,31 with v outside W. For every input it tests the eight old basic rows, all actual accepted T15 projections, and the six new rules above. Any remaining input stays OPEN.

The producer chain gives 145248180 eligible covered-target geometries, 121690 remaining after the old rows and conservative T15 lookup, and 91225 after the new rules (26880,29955,34390 at targets1,7,31). These numbers are unaudited producer evidence until independently reconstructed. No feasibility exclusion was used for the ten-hole final remainder.

Relevant producer files are higher_hole_geometry_census.cpp, higher_hole_t15_lookup.py, higher_hole_t15_filter.cpp, and ten_covered_partial_a8_filter.cpp. No unrestricted same-face T15 shortcut is used by that conservative lookup. The exact remaining bytes are in ten_covered_after_partial_a8_v1.bin, v7.bin, and v31.bin.

Even after this partial coverage is audited, the remaining geometries still require proofs for all their realizing matchings. No complete ten- hole covered-target, A8, A10, or P6 conclusion is asserted.

TEN_HOLE_FREE_CLOSURE.md — Ten-hole P6 with both endpoints free

Ten-hole P6 with both endpoints free

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer. Proposed complete proof relative to the listed imports and a finite hole-geometry census; independent review pending. The covered-target ten-hole branch and full P6 remain open.

Exact claim

For every short 27-edge matching M of Q6, every free root u, and every free target v of opposite parity, there is a Hamilton u--v path containing every edge of M. Only short new edges are used.

Imports and dependency map
  1. Full eight-hole P6, including covered targets, from EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_CLOSURE.md and its final independent review.
  2. The unified cut transfer in HIGHER_HOLE_UNIFIED_TRANSFER.md, including its eight unconditional ten-hole rows and its marked T15 rows. This new transfer must itself pass independent review before this claim is accepted.
  3. The 24 complete marked T15 cores accepted in the final eight-hole review: {0,1,2,4,5,7,8,10,13,14,15,18,19,21,23,24,25,27,31,32,35,37,38,44}. IDs refer to t15_analytic_geometry.json; all required matchings are arbitrary complete-graph matchings, and both specified omissions matter.
  4. The full geometric T15 split case in Q4_RICH_GLUING.md, with accepted independent Q4_RICH_GLUING_REVIEW.md/.json. After translating the minority hole to 0, this case has a coordinate with exactly two of the five odd holes in its one-face and with the two omitted holes in different faces. It applies at both positive and zero original crossing counts.
  5. Adjacent minority/included-hole augmentation to T44_5 is also permitted by the lookup, but does not occur in the independent input domain here.

No unrestricted T15 theorem, higher-hole P6 theorem, or matching sample stands in for these imports. The finite work below is geometry coverage; the full matching quantifiers are supplied by the imported local theorems.

1. Endpoint-symmetric short augmentation

Suppose two free vertices x,y of M are adjacent.

If {x,y}≠{u,v}, at least one of u,v remains free after adding xy. Apply full eight-hole P6 to M+xy, rooted at that still-free endpoint and targeted at the other endpoint. The other endpoint may now be covered, which is explicitly allowed by the eight-hole import. Reverse the path if necessary. It contains M and has the required endpoints.

If xy=uv, apply full eight-hole P6 to M+uv with any remaining free root r and a short neighbor s as target. Close the Hamilton r--s path by the short edge rs. This edge cannot already be the endpoint edge of a path on 64 vertices; it is also not a matching edge since r is free. The resulting Hamilton cycle contains M+uv. Delete uv to obtain the required u--v path containing M.

Therefore the only new domain has all ten holes independent, including both endpoints. Translate u to 0, write the other even holes as Z with |Z|=4, and the odd holes as W with |W|=5 and v∈W. A coordinate permutation takes v to 7 or 31 according to its distance 3 or 5 from 0; distance 1 is excluded by independence.

2. Sufficient cuts tested on the independent domain

For every coordinate put A on the target side and calculate a=|Z∩A|, b=|W∩A|.

The eight universally sufficient rows are

(1,2),(2,3),(2,2),(3,3),(1,3),(2,4),(4,3),(2,5).

Otherwise use the two T15 rows:

  • For (a,b)=(3,2), choose any two of the three A even nonroot holes as bridge sources. The sole B nonroot even hole is the T15 minority; the three B odd holes are its included majority holes; the two bridge mirrors are its marked omissions.
  • For (a,b)=(1,4), choose any two A odd holes excluding the free target and any hole mirrored to the root. The sole B odd hole is the minority; the three B nonroot even holes are its included majority holes; the bridge mirrors are its two marked omissions.

Translate each B vertex by the minority and delete the cut coordinate. This actual cube isomorphism normalizes the minority to 0 and all five majority holes to odd labels of Q5. Accept a choice only when it belongs to one of the 24 audited marked cores, or the audited split case above. The unified transfer supplies the full global path for every realizing original matching of any geometry with such a choice.

3. Finite coverage obligation and producer evidence

The finite assertion to be independently checked is:

Every set {0}∪Z∪W of ten independent vertices of Q6, with |Z|=4 even, |W|=5 odd, and target v=7 or 31 in W, has a sufficient row or an accepted marked T15 choice from Section 2.

Producer files higher_hole_geometry_census.cpp, higher_hole_t15_lookup.py, and higher_hole_t15_filter.cpp enumerate the larger domain where only Z∪W is independent. There are 56805 residual free-target geometries for v=7 after the eight basic rows, all handled by accepted T15 choices. For v=31 the corresponding count is 51935; 51875 have accepted T15 choices. Each of the remaining 60 has a member of W adjacent to root 0, and hence was already handled by Section 1. No infeasibility exclusion is used in these free-target counts.

These producer counts are supporting diagnostics, not independent proof certificates by themselves. The reviewer must independently regenerate the complete independent-hole domain, reconstruct the actual marked projections and accepted orbit maps, and confirm that no input remains. No extrapolation from a random matching or from one Hamilton witness is used.

4. Conclusion and limits

Once the precise finite assertion in Section 3 and the new transfer are independently accepted, Sections 1--2 prove the exact free-target ten-hole claim. This does not prove ten-hole covered targets, any complete 12--18-hole layer, full T15, or full P6. Those obligations remain in the active goal.

THREE_MATCHINGS_DISCONNECTION.md — Blocking three boundary pairings

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：a1f87ead5d1567fb8c892b8617aa4e9afae75f7555d573ef0de47866fe2013e2。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：EIGHT_HOLE_FULL_REVIEW.json, T15_CORE0_FULL_REVIEW.json。

Blocking three boundary pairings

Date: 2026-11-01. Proof-writer; independent review pending.

Claim

Let V be a set of even cardinality N>=6. For any collection of at most three perfect matchings R_i on the complete graph on V, there is a perfect matching D such that the multigraph D union R_i is disconnected for every i. Common edges count twice in this multigraph, but connectivity is the same as in the ordinary edge-set union.

Proof

The empty collection is immediate. Repeat a member if necessary so the collection has three entries, with repetitions allowed.

If N>=10, choose an edge e1 of R1. At most two edges of R2 meet its two vertices, so R2, having at least five edges, has a disjoint edge e2. At most four edges of R3 meet the four chosen vertices, so R3 has an edge e3 disjoint from both. Complete the three disjoint edges to a perfect matching D on the remaining even number of vertices. For each i, the shared edge ei is a two-vertex component of D union Ri: its endpoints already have their only partner in both matchings. Since N>2, the union is disconnected.

For N=6 or 8 relabel V so R1 is the canonical consecutive pairing. This loses no generality: every perfect matching can be sent to that pairing by a vertex bijection, which preserves connectivity and sends the other two matchings to arbitrary perfect matchings on the same set. There are respectively 15 and 105 perfect matchings. The certificate three_matchings_disconnection.json lists every matching and, for every ordered choice of R2,R3, supplies an index of a D whose union with each of R1,R2,R3 is disconnected. There are 225 and 11025 pairs, including equal matchings. three_matchings_disconnection.py checks each union by graph traversal. A fresh checker must verify matching-list coverage, the complete rectangular index set and every specified D; failed search is never a certificate. Undo the relabeling to conclude. QED.

Application principle

Suppose a construction, for every auxiliary boundary pairing D, supplies a pairing R such that D union R is connected. If at most three specific pairings are forbidden and N>=6, the construction has a permissible choice: choose D from the claim to rule out all three forbidden outputs. This respects the quantifiers; it does not assert that one can prescribe R independently of D.

THREE_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md — Z15：三个奇孔同侧的避目标圈转移

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：9e8208e1e71e18386158c4f43bed33d185b0d4c4acad3347235f130dfe403753。

关联审计（以其实际接受范围为准）：FOUR_HOLE_SOL_HIGH_REVIEW.json。

Z15：三个奇孔同侧的避目标圈转移

日期：2026-11-01。状态：新证明草稿，待独立审计。完整 P6 未证明。

命题与依赖

设 M 是 Q6 的短匹配，孔为 u,z,w,t，p(u)=p(z)≠p(w)=p(t)，指定 p(v)≠p(u)。若存在坐标 i 满足

vi=wi=ti≠zi,

则存在包含 M 的 Hamilton u—v 路径。不限制 u 位于哪一面。

依赖 N8、N10，以及 TWO_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md 的 N14。同奇偶双孔的避孔圈是两层都使用的输入；本定理不依赖完整 P6。

证明

平移取 u=0，于是 z 偶、w,t,v 奇。若目标自由，用 N8。若 z 与 w 或 t 相邻，添加该短边，再用 N10。因此以下目标被覆盖且 z 不与 w,t 相邻。

令 h=M(v)，M*=(M⧵{vh})∪{hu}。沿 i 切分，令 A 包含 v,w,t，B 包含 z。M* 的孔恰为这四点，hu 是唯一可能的长边及唯一同偶边。记跨边为 C*，端口为 XA,XB。A 的孔数为三，因此跨边数为正奇数。

1. 至少一个可用桥接点

两个候选 w⊕ei,t⊕ei 都在 B，同为偶点，且均不等于 z，因为排除了 z 与 w,t 相邻的情形。

若候选不等于原自由点 u，则原来必由 MB 覆盖：它不是孔，而跨面邻点为原孔。由 M 变为 M*，只有 u,h 的匹配伙伴发生变化（v∈A），所以除候选 u,h 外覆盖性质不变。

若 u,h 都在 B，新边 hu 在 B 内，两个候选即使等于其中之一也被 MB* 覆盖。若 u,h 都在 A，它们不等于候选，覆盖也不变。若 u,h 分处两面，则它们中只有位于 B 的那个可能是失去内部覆盖的候选。两个候选不同，故至少另一个仍由 MB* 覆盖。

交换 w,t 后，选定 b=t⊕ei 被 MB* 覆盖，记 r=MB*(b)。

2. A 侧避目标圈与转移

在偶数个点 XA∪{t} 上任取完整图完美配对 D。集合至少含两个点，故 D 非空。令 LA=MA*∪D，则其孔恰为同奇偶的 v,w。N14 给出包含 LA、覆盖 A⧵{v} 的圈 CA。

删除 D，得到覆盖 A⧵{v} 的顶点不交非平凡路径族，端点集恰为 XA∪{t}。给 XA 各端点接回真实 C* 边，给端点 t 接短边 tb。所得路径族内点全在 A⧵{v}，端点恰为 XB∪{b}。把各段缩成形式边，得到匹配 R。

3. 消去 B 侧唯一冲突

MB* 与 R 恰在顶点 b 发生覆盖冲突。令 s=R(b)，则 s∈XB。因为 b,r 原由 MB* 覆盖，而 z,s 不被它覆盖，四点 b,r,z,s 两两不同。构造

LB=(MB*⧵{br})∪(R⧵{bs})∪{rs}.

该匹配恰不覆盖 z,b：R 原填满全部 XB 并额外覆盖 b；删除两条冲突边后留下 z,b,r,s，补 rs 后仅留 z,b。z,b 同偶，故 N14 给出包含 LB、覆盖 B⧵{b} 的圈 CB。

4. 展开并恢复原目标

把辅助边 rs 替换成原匹配边 rb，再接从 b 到 s 的那条 R 所代表的 A 路径。将其余 R⧵{bs} 边全部展开。

原圈 CB 各 B 点除 b 外出现一次；b 在 rs 展开中恢复一次。各展开段的 A 内点互不相交并覆盖 A⧵{v}。因此得到覆盖 Q6⧵{v} 的单圈，包含全部 M*。即使 br 恰为长边 hu，也在此步真实恢复并保留到下一步；不假定 br 是短边。

删除 hu，在端点 h 接回原边 hv，得到所需 Hamilton u—v 路径。原匹配全部恢复；D,rs,R,hu 均删除或展开，新增边仅为面内输入圈的短边和桥接短边 tb。证毕。

与 Z14 的合并

对每个满足 vi≠zi 的坐标，若 wi≠ti，用 Z14；若 wi=ti=vi，用 Z15。两者均不适用的情况只剩：在每个 v,z 不同的坐标上，wi=ti=zi。

这只是几何充分条件的共同例外，不是完整证明的反例。Z9、Z11、Z13 等仍可处理其中一些；六孔以上也尚未统一处理。

Any permitted cycle has degree2 at the uncovered vertex0, whose only remaining short neighbors are p,q. It must contain p--0--q. The positive certificate supplies1024 short forests S on Q5-U. Every covered vertex of K has degree1, each of the five included holes has degree2, and no component is a cycle. If F lacks pq, put a=F(p),b=F(q). These four vertices are distinct. Replace pa,qb by ab to give an arbitrary complete-graph perfect matching F' on K'. Contracting the labelled path a--p--q--b proves connectedness of F+P equivalent to connectedness of F'+P'. The compressed edge ab need not be short; the local rank domain permits it.

The primary matching-connectivity theorem, Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof, Corollary3.5, bounds rank_GF2(H_22)<=2^(22/2-1)=1024 on ALL complete-graph perfect matchings. Its generic source/domain alignment is recorded in A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md. For each row the supplied1024 P' rows and1024 valid arbitrary-matching columns give rank1024. Their complete rows consequently span H_22's row space. Every matching column is nonzero: cyclically link consecutive oriented required edges. Hence some P' connects the arbitrary F'. Undo contraction and expand P's paths through S to obtain the required simple29-cycle, retaining all F edges. Step 1: remove adjacent free holes using the full preceding layer

Suppose two holes x,y are adjacent. Add xy to M, obtaining a short 27-edge matching. If xy differs from uv, at least one of u,v stays free. Use that endpoint as the root in the complete ten-hole theorem and the other as target. Reverse the resulting Hamilton path if necessary. The path contains M and has the prescribed endpoints; its extra xy is short.

If xy=uv, choose another free root r of the augmented matching and any cube neighbor s of r. There are ten free vertices after augmentation, so r exists and is distinct from u,v. The full ten-hole theorem supplies a Hamilton r--s path containing M and uv. The edge rs is not already in this 64-vertex path, because it joins its two endpoints. Add rs to form a Hamilton cycle, then delete uv. The resulting Hamilton u--v path contains M. Neither the deleted uv nor rs was an original required edge incident to a free vertex.

It therefore remains to treat matchings whose entire twelve-hole set is independent. This step genuinely uses the full ten-hole theorem, including its covered-target quantifier when needed.

Twenty-seven actual single-cherry local classifications

2026-11-01. ARIS proof-writer candidate, independent verification pending.

Exact conditional local theorem

For each of the27 rows in TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_summary.json, put H=minority union majority, U=omitted, K=V(Q5) minus H. The row specifies an included hole h and two covered vertices p,q. For every perfect matching F of the COMPLETE graph on K, a cycle on exactly V(Q5) minus U containing F and adding only cube edges exists if and only if pq is not an edge of F. The statement transports under common cube automorphisms of all marked data (H,U,h,{p,q}). It does not assert any unlisted input.

All rows have22 covered endpoints. Their types are T28 (2:8 holes, three majority omissions) or T19 (1:9 holes, four majority omissions). Every neighbor of h outside U is precisely p or q, and both are in K. Thus any permitted cycle must contain p--h--q. If F contains pq this forms an isolated triangle, while the retained graph has29 or28 vertices. The forbidden pair is therefore a genuine necessary obstruction.

Sufficiency by a reduced rank certificate

The certificate supplies512 short forests S. Each covers V(Q5) minus U, has degree one at K, degree two at H minus U, and no cycle. These forests have eighteen edges for T28, seventeen for T19. Each consists of eleven paths, and the h path is exactly p--h--q. Its endpoint matching P(S) contains pq. Delete that pair to obtain P'(S) on K'=K minus {p,q}, with twenty endpoints.

For any F not containing pq, write Fp=a and Fq=b. The four vertices p,q,a,b are distinct. Delete pa,qb from F and replace them by ab, obtaining a perfect matching F' on K'. The labelled graph F+P(S) is connected if and only if F'+P'(S) is connected: contract its path a--p--q--b. This equivalence is an exact graph operation, not an assumption that the compressed matching remains short.

The complete matching-connectivity matrix on K' has GF(2) rank 2^(20/2-1)=512 by Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof, Corollary3.5; the same general primary-source import is recorded in A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md (arXiv1211.1506, DOI10.1145/3148227). For every claimed geometry the512 supplied reduced forest pairings and512 supplied arbitrary matching columns give a full-rank512 submatrix. Thus the selected complete rows span the full matching-connectivity row space. Every column is nonzero, by cyclically joining the ten edges of its perfect matching. Some selected P'(S) is therefore connected with the arbitrary F'. Undo the contraction, then expand P(S) to S. The result is the required simple cycle. Common required/forest physical edges cannot occur in a successful connected pairing union: they would be an isolated labelled two-edge component; the particular common pair pq was excluded explicitly.

The finite checks of forest legality, the fixed cherry and exact binary rank are the only computational hypotheses. No generator exhaustiveness, deficient-rank negative inference or full-Q6 theorem is used.

Certificate formats and independent obligations

Each summary row gives its prefix TWELVE_NEW_FORCED_orbit_XXX. There are512 unsigned-byte records in each forest or pairing file:

  • _forests.bin: 36 bytes per T28 record, 34 per T19 record.
  • _full_pairs.bin: 22 bytes, the full eleven endpoint pairs.
  • _pairs.bin: 20 bytes, the ten reduced pairs.
  • _columns.bin: 20 bytes, arbitrary perfect matchings on K'.
  • _matrix.bin, _pivots.bin, _combos.bin: 512 rows of64 bytes, little-bit-first; pivots use highest-bit positions and combos select original rows by XOR.
  • _config.txt and .json: actual geometry and extraction metadata.

Independent verification must reconstruct every forest and its full pairing, check exactly the available neighbors of h and its forced physical cherry, delete pq and compare the reduced pairing, validate every reduced column, reconstruct all512^2 connectivity bits, and check rank512. The source full-matrix column indices in metadata explain construction but need not be trusted; the resulting reduced certificates stand on their own. Total:13824 forests and7077888 connectivity bits.

The author extraction uses independent columns of an already produced 512-by-1024 matrix and contracts the selected columns. It is merely a producer; the target theorem does not rely on trusting those original matrices or their rank metadata.

Q6 application boundary

An actual cut may use this local theorem only after checking the marked geometry, legal sources and the hypotheses of HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_TRANSFER.md / HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json, including exclusion of the global root from the actual pair {p,q}. Original shortness alone does not ensure the compressed F lacks pq; the accepted safe-completion argument supplies that fact. No actual Q6 coverage count is claimed here. The compressed edge ab need not be short. Suppression of the labelled path a--p--q--b gives the exact component-preserving equivalence

F + P(S) is one alternating cycle
    iff F' + P'(S) is one alternating cycle.

This is the single-pair case of the accepted reduced-rank criterion in HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_TRANSFER.md Section5, accepted by HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.json. The earlier structural explanation is FORCED_CHERRY_RANK_REDUCTION.md. For a single pair R={pq}, acyclicity of the labelled graph F+R is exactly pq not in F. No stronger matching restriction is introduced.

The primary complete-graph matching-connectivity rank upper bound is rank_GF2(H_22)<=2^(22/2-1)=1024, Corollary3.5 of Cygan--Kratsch--Nederlof, Fast Hamiltonicity checking via bases of perfect matchings. The generic source version and arbitrary-matching domain alignment are recorded in A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_PRIMARY_SOURCE.md. Only this upper bound is imported; no bipartite restriction or experimental rank extrapolation is used.

For each class, the supplied1024 P' rows restricted to the supplied1024 arbitrary matching columns have GF(2) rank1024. Their complete rows in H_22 are therefore independent and span its full row space. Every matching column is nonzero: order and orient the eleven edges of F' and cyclically connect the end of each to the start of the next. If every selected row vanished at F', so would their complete row space, contradicting this nonzero column. Hence one selected P' connects with F'.

Undo suppression and expand P(S)'s disjoint paths through its stored S. The result is one connected simple29-cycle on exactly Q5-U containing all F edges. Its introduced edges are short. A common required/forest endpoint pair would be an isolated labelled2-cycle and cannot occur in a successful connected24-terminal union; thus no length-one forest path duplicates a physical F edge. Combined with the isolated-triangle necessity, this proves the exact iff once the finite data pass review. No exhaustive enumeration of F or of all possible forests is needed.

Frozen finite certificate interface

Every one of the ten prefixes has EXACTLY1024 selected forest, full-pair, reduced-pair, column, matrix and rank-evidence records:

The local configuration supplies eight holes, three omissions and the two forced endpoints. Metadata records the search selection indices. The producer uses a general exact-degree/DSU forest generator and evaluates the reduced connectivity rows directly; its completeness is not a premise. All ten runs reached full reduced rank before their cap. The finite theorem depends only on the saved witnesses and rank data.

A fresh checker must independently verify all10240 full forests, exact support/degrees/shortness/acyclicity, forced physical cherry, full endpoint pairing and reduced pairing. It must validate all10240 arbitrary matching columns and recompute all10*1024^2=10485760 connectivity bits, retaining matching-edge labels. It may recompute GF(2) rank or verify every pivot as the supplied row-combination XOR, with distinct highest bits0..1023. These obligations are not replaced by the producer full_rank fields.

All fifty actual B choices and simultaneous transport

In the actual local labels set Z0={7,11,13,19,21}, E={1,2,4,8,16}. Choose t in Z0 and an unordered pair {w,b} subset E. Put S=E minus {w,b}, J=(Z0 minus {t}) union S and U=S. Strict scope and acceptance gates

Direct compatibility and the bipartite completion lemma

Form L_A as stated. The original matching is short and bipartite. In the internal-target case,31 is odd and h even; the replacement w odd--h even is bipartite and legal because w was a hole. Bipartite path-joining lemma. For disjoint paths with equally many even and odd endpoints, a bipartite matching of the endpoints can join all paths into one cycle when the nondegenerate component count here is at least3. The numbers of EE-ended and OO-ended paths are equal. If both are zero, orient all EO paths from E to O and concatenate them cyclically by O--E edges. Otherwise alternate the EE and OO paths in a cycle using opposite-color connecting edges, then insert each EO path into a suitable connector with its orientation chosen accordingly. Each endpoint gets one connector; connectors join distinct path components. Thus no connector duplicates a forest edge. Call their matching D.

TWELVE_STAR_MAXIMAL_A_REDUCTION.md — A conditional finite route for the six remaining root-star geometries

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：9245ab20cd90223e3c2db6690686eb644ea60e3bbb2ffcc31c4f98c27470d49f。

A conditional finite route for the six remaining root-star geometries

2026-11-02. ARIS proof-writer candidate. The universal finite A witness obligation below is OPEN. This file proves a proposed reduction, not Q6.

Original domain

Use the accepted235-record residual and its six normalized representatives: u=0, v=31, W={1,2,4,8,16,32}, and Z one of

  1. {39,43,45,51,53};
  2. {39,43,45,51,63};
  3. {39,43,45,54,63};
  4. {39,43,51,60,63};
  5. {39,43,53,57,63};
  6. {39,43,53,58,63}.

Let A be the face with bit32 zero, B the other face, and J={1,2,4,8,16}. Identify A with Q5 and write bar(x)=x xor32. The original holes are {u} union Z union W. Let M be any realizing short26-edge matching and L=M internal to A. Put T={bar(z):z in Z}. Every t in T is originally A-covered and cannot be a crossing port, because its actual short mirror is a B hole. Thus L covers every vertex of T. A's original covered graph G is Q5 induced on the15 nonzero even vertices and the11 odd nonunit vertices. The graph G and T depend only on the displayed representative.

Extend L by ADDING short edges of G to any inclusion-maximal matching L of G. Original edges are never changed. Necessarily |L|<=11 and its unmatched even vertices number15-|L|>=4. The candidate finite enumeration must cover every such L containing all of T, not a sample.

The finite positive A obligation

For every inclusion-maximal L* of G covering T, supply:

  • q: an unmatched even vertex of G;
  • t in T minus {v}, adjacent to q;
  • distinct w,b in J, and S=J minus {w,b};
  • a legal short forest P on A minus {u,v} with degree one at K=A minus {u,q,v,b}, degree two at q,b, no cycle, and edge q-t;
  • an accepted B marked input as specified below.

Define L' by replacing v-h with w-h if v is covered by L, where h=L(v); otherwise put L'=L. Require the labelled union P+L' to be acyclic. Duplicate required/forest edges count as two-edge cycles. This positive condition is what must be verified for EVERY enumerated L. Neither a deficient rank nor finite random tests establish it.

Let X be the vertices of G unmatched by L. Define X'=X when v is covered, and X'=(X minus {v}) union {w} otherwise. The path endpoints of P+L' are exactly Q=(X' minus {q}) union S. Their even/odd counts are equal: the original unmatched-port surplus is four even vertices, then q removes one even and S adds three odd vertices. The union has at least three path components because |X|>=4 and |Q|=|X|+2>=6.

Any bipartite path forest with balanced endpoint counts and at least three components admits an opposite-parity matching D of its endpoints joining all components into one cycle. Indeed orient each even-odd component consistently and arrange the even-even and odd-odd components alternately (their numbers are equal), inserting the even-odd components between them. Pair consecutive exposed ends cyclically. If there are no same-parity components, orient all components from even to odd and join cyclically. All added pairs are opposite-parity and join distinct components, so no two-edge component is created. Hence C_A=P union L' union D is a cycle on A minus {u,v}, with edge q-t. D need not be short; every such completion edge will be deleted.

Why maximal internal matchings suffice

Let h=M(v) be the ACTUAL target mate. Replace original edge v-h in the global matching by the auxiliary edge w-h, obtaining F. If h is in A, its internal part L' is L minus {v-h} plus {w-h}. If h is in B then h=63, L'=L, and the actual crossing v-h is replaced by a virtual crossing w-h. This is the only potentially long crossing and will be removed at the final step. Its endpoints, not its direction, are used in gluing.

In every case L' is a submatching of L'. If v was already L-covered, its mate cannot change in an extension. If v was originally unmatched in A but becomes covered by L, the artificial edge w-h is simply a completion pair; no original edge is asserted there. Thus D=D union (L' minus L') is a matching and C_A=P union L' union D. Its endpoint domain is exactly Q=(X' minus {q}) union S, where X' is the actual A crossing-port set after the possible replacement v by w. All added L' minus L' edges may be treated as completion edges. This also handles the case of an originally crossing v that becomes internally matched only in L. Therefore a certificate for L supplies the required A cycle for its original submatching L without changing the original M.

The chosen t belongs to T minus {v}, so it was internally L-covered even before maximalization. The chosen q remains an actual even crossing port. This distinction is essential for the next opening operation.

Open the A cycle and form the exact B input

Delete every edge of D AND the short edge q-t from C_A. These edges are disjoint: D avoids q, and t is covered by L'. A nonempty proper edge deletion from a single cycle is a path forest. Attach all actual F crossings, including the possible long w-63 edge, the three new short bridges s-bar(s) for s in S, and the new short bridge t-bar(t).

At q, deleting q-t makes room for its original crossing. At t, its original internal required edge remains, and deleting q-t makes room for t-bar(t). The vertex bar(t) is an original B hole in Z and is now consumed; it is not a conflict vertex. Each Y={bar(s):s in S} is an original internally B-covered vertex, not a port or original hole. The only conflicts are at these three same-parity Y vertices. Their original short mates are distinct opposite-parity pendant endpoints outside every transferred endpoint. Suppress these three conflicts as in the accepted uniform transfer, retaining their expansion paths.

The resulting arbitrary B matching has holes {32} union (Z minus {bar(t)}) union Y, with precisely Y omitted by the desired local cycle. This is T17: one minority hole32, seven majority holes, and three marked majority omissions. The only remaining short neighbors of32 after omitting Y are p=bar(w), r=bar(b). Both remain originally internally B-covered and outside the transferred endpoints, Y and bar(t). This remains true for a virtual w-63 crossing:63 differs from these weight-two vertices. Their original B edges are unchanged and short, so the compressed matching cannot contain the same-parity edge p-r. Thus an accepted exact local classification with obstruction p-r supplies the B cycle. The finite witness must verify the simultaneous marked geometry against an ACCEPTED B registry; no unrestricted T17 claim is used.

Expanding yields a cycle on Q6 minus {u,v} containing the whole modified matching F, with only short physical edges apart from the auxiliary w-h. Delete w-h, prepend u-w and append h-v to the resulting Hamilton w--h path. This gives the desired Hamilton u--v path on all64 vertices, preserving all original M edges and adding only cube edges.

Remaining proof obligations

The mathematical reduction requires fresh independent audit, including the maximalization lift and the covered-source bridge. Its finite premise still requires exhaustive inclusion-maximal L* enumeration for the six T sets, with a positive q,t,w,b,P witness for EACH case, and independently verified B registry transports. Existing force-opening rank8031/7998 files contain useful legal forests, but prove no universal A statement. A deterministic complete witness cover could suffice even though no full-rank arbitrary-matching opening theorem has been obtained.

No235-record decrement, complete twelve-hole theorem, or full P6 closure is asserted by this conditional reduction.

N14。 若 m≥5，L⊆K(Qm) 恰有两个同奇偶的孔 a,b，则存在遍历 V(Qm)⧵{a} 的圈，包含 L，且新增边均短。

令 ϵ=1 若两孔偶，ϵ=−1 若两孔奇。L 覆盖点的偶点数减奇点数是 −2ϵ，因此 L 中同偶边数减同奇边数为 −ϵ。新增短边不改变后一个差值。任意圈满足“偶点数减奇点数＝同偶边数减同奇边数”，所以 C 不可能仅覆盖 L 的端点。唯一可补进的顶点是 b，故 C 恰覆盖除 a 外全部顶点。证毕。这也是 N10 证明步骤 3、4 的独立表述。

Z14 证明

平移令 u=0，故 z 偶，w,t,v 奇。若 v 是自由点，使用 N8。以下 v 被覆盖，记 h=M(v)，并令

M*=(M⧵{vh})∪{hu}.

沿命题中的 i 切分，把包含 v 的面记为 A。交换 w,t 后可令 v,w∈A，z,t∈B。令 C* 为全部跨面匹配边，XA,XB 为其端口。跨边可能包含长边 hu，以后始终按真实端点转移它。

正跨边分支

因 A 有两个孔，|XA| 为偶数；若非零，至少为二。在 XA 上任取完整图完美配对 D，令

LA=MA*∪D.

这是完整图近完美匹配，孔恰为同奇偶的 v,w。由 N14 得到覆盖 A⧵{v} 的圈 CA，包含 LA，新增边短。

删除非空匹配 D，得到覆盖 A⧵{v} 的互不相交路径族。每个顶点最多失去一条圈边，不产生孤立点；删除至少一条圈边后不留下圈分量。其端点集恰为 XA。给每个端点接回其真实 C* 边，得到内部顶点在 A⧵{v}、端点为 XB 的互不相交路径族。把它们分别缩成形式边，得到完整图匹配 R。

于是

LB=MB*∪R

恰有孔 z,t，二者异奇偶。N10 给出自由根 z 到任一面内短邻点 y 的 Hamilton 路径；加回短边 zy，得到包含 LB 的 Hamilton 圈 CB。这里 y≠z 且 p(y)=p(t)，满足 N10；因面有 32 个顶点，该路径不含两端间的边 zy。

展开 CB 中的全部 R，得到覆盖 Q6⧵{v}、包含全部 M* 的圈。所有 A 内点位于互不相交的展开段中，所有 B 点在 CB 中恰出现一次。删除辅助 hu，在端点 h 接回原边 hv，得到 Hamilton u—v 路径。M 全部恢复，D,R,hu 均已消去或展开，新增边均短。

零跨边分支

若 C*=∅，则 MA* 在 A 恰不覆盖两个奇点 v,w。它的覆盖点中偶点比奇点多二，所以其同偶边数减同奇边数为一。M* 全图唯一的非二部边是同偶边 hu，因此 hu 必完全位于 A。于是原边 vh 也完全位于 A，原 M 与 M* 的跨边集相同，都为空。

因此原短匹配 M 不使用方向 i，至多使用五个方向。直接用五方向论文的未覆盖根端点定理，得到所需路径。这一步没有把原匹配扩展到含长边的输入，也没有假设完整 P6。

两分支覆盖全部情况。证毕。

推论及范围

用整数编码写，Z14 的几何条件为

((vxorz)and(wxort))≠0.

特别地，若 w,t 在六个坐标全部不同，则任何奇 v 不可能等于偶 z，故存在所需坐标。这关闭“两个异于根奇偶的孔互为对跖点”的整个四孔匹配族的全部目标。

若 d(w,t)=4，不满足该条件的奇目标只有两个；若 d(w,t)=2，只有八个。这些计数仅描述该充分条件的例外顶点，不能称为完整 P6 剩余数；其他引理可能继续覆盖它们。未证明其余四孔及六孔以上。

Z7：孔{0,3,13,49}的完整匹配族，一半坐标侧的全部指定终点

日期：2026-11-01。状态：局部证明，独立审读记录见GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.md。完整P6仍开放。

目标与范围

对每个Q6短边匹配M，若其孔恰为{0,3,13,49}，则对每个奇顶点v满足最低位v_0=1，存在包含M的Hamilton 0—v路径。

这包含此前明确记录的全称义务v=61。量词涵盖全部具有该孔配置的匹配，而非仅保存的一个样例。最低位为0的已覆盖奇终点不在本命题范围内。

两个终点的半层排除引理 E1

设m≥5，P为B(Q_m)的完美匹配。三个不同顶点c,d,e满足c与d,e异奇偶，且P中接触c,d,e的边均为短边，并有cd,ce∉P。设

J={j : d_j=e_j≠c_j}。

若在(c,d)、(c,e)处压缩P都产生半层，则P(c)=c⊕e_j，其中j∈J。因此若P(c)的方向不在J，至少一对端点的压缩不含半层，GNS端点定理给出相应的Hamilton路径。

证明：设第一压缩含方向j半层H。P至少含H中除新增伙伴边外的2^(m−2)−1≥7条j方向短边。若第二压缩含方向k半层，Z0说明所有不接触c,e的P短边只能沿k；上述至少7条j边中至多2条接触c,e，故k=j。方向j恰有两个半层，其端点集互为补集；c被两次压缩删除，所以两个半层只能是同一个H。

记S为H端点集、T为其补集，则c,d,e∈T。在第二压缩的Z0结论中，P中接触d的短边没有接触c,e：cd∉P，且d,e同奇偶而P二部。因此P(d)=d⊕e_j∈T。第一压缩新加的P(c)P(d)不可能属于H，故H原已完整包含于P。于是P(c)∈T；cP(c)为短边，T内短边只沿j，所以P(c)=c⊕e_j。最后c与d,e异奇偶且均在T，要求其第j位分别相反，即j∈J。证毕。

Z7证明

沿第0位切分，A为偶数编码顶点，B为奇数编码顶点（这是编码最低位，不是顶点奇偶性）。孔0在A，孔z=3,w=13,t=49在B。

令c=2、d=12、e=48，分别是3、13、49沿第0位的A内邻点。它们均被M_A覆盖：它们不是孔，跨层伙伴却是孔，不能被M跨边覆盖。c为奇顶点，d,e为偶顶点。距离d(c,d)=d(c,e)=3，所以cd,ce∉M_A。

令X_A为原跨边端口，在X_A∪{0}上任取二部完美配对D，得P_A=M_A∪D。该配对存在，因为这恰是二部匹配M_A在A内未覆盖的集合。P_A在c,d,e处的匹配边就是原M_A短边，且cd,ce∉P_A。

以A的五个坐标{1,2,3,4,5}计，E1中的J只有坐标1：c=2只在坐标1为1，而d=12和e=48的支撑分别为{2,3}、{4,5}，没有共同的1位。P_A(c)不等于0，因为c由M_A覆盖而0为原孔。因此P_A(c)的方向不是1。

由E1，P_A至少有Hamilton c—d或c—e延拓。选中哪一个，就把对应的B孔13或49作为Z6中的t，另一奇孔作为w。对任意在B中且已被M覆盖的奇顶点v，Z6（UNBALANCED_TRANSFER.md）与N10给出Hamilton 0—v延拓。

若v为自由奇孔13或49，则使用已证N8四孔自由端点定理（BIPARTITE_NEAR_PERFECT.md）。因此命题所列全部v成立。证毕。

依赖与未解范围

输入依赖：Z0半层刚性、GNS二部完美匹配端点定理、N10、Z6、自由端点分支N8。没有假设完整P6，也没有用有限样例代替全称证明。

本命题关闭UNBALANCED_FOUR_HOLE_CORE.md中根0、目标61的特定全称匹配族；不关闭其他孔配置，也不关闭本孔配置中最低位0的全部已覆盖目标，更不关闭六孔及更多孔。

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：81e0355e3dd647442ba38ea7e0aa48bb0eb36960c8cbd5ac9e0cbdf1c9c588e7。

Z6：一孔/三孔切分到完整图近完美匹配

日期：2026-11-01。状态：局部证明，独立审读记录见GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.md。完整P6仍开放。

命题与假设

设n≥6，M为Q_n短边匹配，恰不覆盖u,z,w,t，其中u,z偶，w,t奇。沿方向i切分成A,B两个Q_(n−1)，u∈A而z,w,t及指定目标v∈B；v奇且被M覆盖。

记C为M的跨层边，X_A,X_B为其端口；c=z⊕e_i、d=t⊕e_i。设存在A内二部配对D，恰覆盖X_A∪{u}，使完美匹配P_A=M_A∪D具有包含P_A的Hamilton c—d路径K_A，且K_A\P_A全部为A内短边。

则M具有Hamilton u—v延拓。

D存在作为二部配对不成问题：M_A为二部匹配，A内未覆盖点为X_A∪{u}，故该集合奇偶平衡。额外路径K_A的存在须另证，不能视为自动。c由M_A覆盖：c奇、u偶，故c不是A唯一的原孔u，其跨层伙伴z是孔，故也不能是跨端口。若d≠u，同理d由M_A覆盖；d=u的边界在以下单独处理。

证明

  1. 以c（奇）到d（偶）的顺序定向K_A。因P_A为完美二部匹配，其匹配边全部沿奇→偶出现。删除D中全部边，得到覆盖A的顶点不交路径族。若d≠u，D不接触c,d，故没有孤立顶点，端点集恰为X_A∪{u,c,d}。若d=u，路径末边属于D，删除后u成为唯一孤立顶点；其他非平凡分段的端点集恰为X_A∪{c}。

  2. 在每个X_A端点接回其C跨边，并加入短跨边cz、dt。得到内部顶点全在A的互不相交路径族，端点集恰为X_B∪{u,z,t}。特别地，d=u时短边dt=ut将孤立顶点u接成路径J=u—t。

  3. 设包含u的路径为J，另一个端点为q。证明q≠v：若d=u，已知q=t。若d≠u，D中接触u的边沿a→u出现，其中a奇、u偶，故u所在分段是该删除边之后的分段。若分段在下一条D边之前结束，则结束端点为奇点，其跨层伙伴q偶。若之后没有D边，则结束于d，转移后q=t。分段不含起点c，所以q≠z。因此q∈X_B且偶，或q=t。v奇且被M覆盖，所以两种情况下均q≠v。

  4. 将J以外各条转移路径缩成形式边，得到K(B)中的匹配R，恰覆盖(X_B∪{z,t}){q}。这些形式边可能同奇偶，不能直接调用二部版本N9。

L_B=M_B∪R是K(B)匹配，恰不覆盖q,w：M_B恰不覆盖X_B∪{z,w,t}，两部分的覆盖点不交。孔q可以偶也可以奇，但目标v始终与另一孔w同奇偶，且v≠q。

  1. 层维数n−1≥5，由GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT.md的N10，L_B具有Hamilton q—v延拓K_B。展开R的每条形式边，再在起点q前接入J（从u到q），得到所需u—v路径。

  2. K_B原先各B顶点出现一次；展开各R及添加J恢复全部A顶点，各段A内点集合互不相交。所有M_A边在这些分段中保留，所有跨边C在步骤2恢复，所有M_B边在K_B中保留。D已全部删除，R已全部展开，其他新增边均为两层内部短边或cz、dt。因此得到包含M的Hamilton u—v路径。证毕。

剩余义务

K_A的存在是唯一额外结构前提。可用GNS完整二部图端点定理：需cd∉P_A，且端点c,d处压缩后无半层。充分条件为cd∉M_A，且M_A中避开c,d的短边至少使用两个方向；Z0随后排除半层。

本命题尚未证明每个四孔匹配都存在这样的一孔/三孔切分，也未证明每个该类切分都能选出合适D和孔t。

P6_FULL_REVIEW.md — Independent final audit of complete P6

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：39a22f9016f616c6f931a2ebe485996bab78e09fdcd12c9d2299e1550af3f462。

Independent final audit of complete P6

Reviewer: /root/p6_final_independent_audit, requested GPT-6.1-sol/high. Same-family review; semantic acceptance is provisional and relative to the explicit imports below. The served backend model is not independently attested.

PASS: complete P6 is proved relative to the explicit accepted imports. All nine complete layers and the root-preserving range reduction are accepted. There are zero remaining predecessor conditions or hole levels.

Exact quantified obligation

For every matching M in the short-edge graph Q6, every u outside V(M), and every v of opposite Hamming parity, a Hamilton u-v path containing M exists. There is no condition that v be free. The intermediate use of arbitrary complete-graph matching edges in local imported proofs does not enlarge the original matching domain or permit long physical edges in the final path. If M is perfect there is no eligible u, so that case is vacuous. Empty and all smaller matchings are within the reduction's quantifier scope.

Independent semantic check of the final implication

Fix an eligible triple (M,u,v). Every edge of M lies in Q6-u. Add cube edges whose endpoints are both free until an inclusion-maximal matching L in Q6-u is reached. Termination follows from strict increase of its cardinality in a finite graph. Every intermediate matching contains M and leaves u free. The construction makes no restriction on v; in particular it can cover v.

There are two exhaustive cases. If every neighbor of u is covered by L, no edge can be added in full Q6: edges away from u are excluded by deleted- root maximality, and edges at u are excluded by the covered other endpoint. Thus the explicit full-cube maximal-matching theorem gives |L|>=24. Otherwise select a free cube neighbor a of u. The matching L+ua is maximal in full Q6. An edge with both endpoints still free could touch neither u nor a and would contradict maximality of L in Q6-u. Hence |L|+1>=24 and |L|>=23. The temporary ua is discarded; it is never an added requirement on the Hamilton path. The upper bound |L|<=31 follows from the free root.

Therefore L has exactly one of 2,4,6,8,10,12,14,16,18 holes. Apply the corresponding complete endpoint theorem with this same u and v. The layer has the correct exact cardinality, its required edges are cube edges, its root is free, and its target is of opposite parity. Its covered-target scope is essential when augmentation has covered v. The resulting path contains L and therefore M. Its endpoints remain the prescribed u,v. This implication contains no induction assumption or hidden uniform choice of an auxiliary witness. The chosen L and subsequent local witnesses can depend on M,u,v.

The imported review scopes explicitly include every realizing original short matching, with arbitrary compressed local matchings where required. The final assembly's semantic argument above was checked independently.

The higher source gates prove conditional implications, not unconditional layers. Complete12 discharges the predecessor in the full14 assembly; complete14 must then discharge the full16 reductions; complete16 discharges the independently proved implication complete16=>complete18. An earlier immutable report's contemporaneous 'not established' or 'full P6 open' statement is not a new hypothesis once the precise antecedent is supplied. The restricted R4_DOUBLE_BRIDGE_REVIEW import allows only its checked bridge labels. Its actual uses are confined to core4/core24 and their eight-hole assembly; the complete core audits explicitly discharge the exclusions. No unrestricted opening/rank claim is inferred from a deficient matrix.

Explicit external mathematical inputs

Havel and Krivanek (1982), 'On maximal matchings in Q6 and a conjecture of R. Forcade', Theorem2, printed page125: every inclusion-maximal matching in full Q6 has at least24 edges. This is an explicit literature import, bound via ROOTED_RANGE_REVIEW and its proof; its original classification proof is not re-proved here. A maximum-cardinality statement would not suffice. Source: https://dml.cz/bitstream/handle/10338.dmlcz/106137/CommentatMathUnivCarol_023-1982-1_10.pdf

The lower proof packages explicitly import Fink's perfect-matching extension result, the Fink-Muetze extension/avoidance/endpoint theorems (including Theorems2,8,9,12 where used), their short-added-edge convention, the established five-direction endpoint theorem, and the individually audited Q4/Q5 classifications and finite witnesses. Its rows/columns range over all complete-graph perfect matchings, not just bipartite matchings; the two-terminal double-labelled edge has the stated two-edge-cycle convention. Counterexample and reproducibility checks

The adversarial pass targeted: perfect M with no free root; empty M; augmentation covering the target; an uncovered neighbor of u; confusion between maximal and maximum matching; accidentally retaining ua; skipping hole levels23 through31 edges; reversing the direction of full16=>full18; substituting free-target results for covered-target predecessors; and circular import of full P6. The proof handles each boundary explicitly. No counterexample to a used final implication was found.

The independent checker reconstructs all2,048 ordered opposite-parity endpoint normalizations and their cube adjacency preservation. It checks the rooted23-edge extremal witness directly, including all addable edges and all six maximal full-cube completions. The witness confirms consistency of the endpoint of the range; it is not used to prove the universal bound.

The recursive checker rehashes declared source/evidence bindings, handles nested legacy maps as maps rather than filenames, resolves digest aliases, and checks report dependency acyclicity. Auxiliary comparison evidence is not promoted to a theorem premise. No live RUN_STATE/PROOF_CHECK_STATE or A6_CONSEQUENCES_STATE_REVIEW is used. The publisher's future mutation of research ledgers therefore cannot stale a theorem premise in this audit. Frozen proofs, existing certificates and research ledgers are unchanged.

This audit is same-family/provisional, not cross-family semantic acceptance, Lean verification, peer review, a novelty claim, or a theorem about all complete-graph matchings on64 vertices.

Final checked result

The final independent run rehashed 5155 distinct bound files, traversed 96 accepted review nodes and 386 bound report edges, and checked 2274 auxiliary evidence bindings. There are no missing/stale bindings, dependency cycles or unresolved imported conditions in the supported declared schemas. Directly bound manifest input/output files are checked; arbitrary undocumented metadata is not recursively interpreted. The final14 source is exactly the independently reconstructed disjoint20/5 orbit union. On each target, the final16 star and small-cut retained sets partition the same source exactly and have empty intersection; their positive union therefore leaves no record. The complete16 antecedent discharges the precise complete16=>complete18 implication. Final14, final16 and final18 each have zero free and covered residuals.

This closes the original arbitrary short-matching theorem with every free root and every opposite-parity target, including targets covered before or during augmentation. All substantive imported premises remain explicit; no full original literature proof or large historical finite computation was repeated here. O2 非完美匹配满足 P6 取自由 u、任意 cube 邻点 v；对目标不强加自由性
O3 闭合边 uv 不已在路径中 64 顶点简单路径两端之间的边不可能是路径边；否则整条路只有一条边
O4 P6 与维数六 Conj2 的量词相同 均为 short M、自由根、任意异奇偶目标，包括已覆盖目标
O5 坐标置换没有损失 图自同构且可逆；保留匹配、覆盖、奇偶、Hamilton 性质
O6 少于六个方向时仍可作六维纤维分解 把实际方向集合补成恰六个坐标；所有 M 边留在纤维内
O7 各纤维 Hamilton 圈都存在 直接应用 C6，允许局部匹配完美、空或非完美
O8 可删除一条非匹配圈边 圈在 u_i 处度为 2，匹配在该点度≤1
O9 首纤维最终端点奇偶性满足 P6 k=2^(n−6) 偶；k−1 次内部边使右部奇偶反转；跨纤维边右部不变
O10 首纤维 P6 的自由端点参数正确 自由的是 v1，故用 (根 v1, 目标 u1)，无向路可倒读
O11 拼接确实是单个 spanning 简单圈 各纤维路径顶点不交，按循环次序逐条连接，覆盖全部纤维
O12 n=7 商图 Q1 退化情形 用两个商点的循环次序；两条实际跨纤维边不同，因为 u1≠v1
O13 低维 2≤n≤5 实际方向数≤n≤5，满足既有 Theorem 4
O14 RS 推论未越界 仅全维数 n≤6，或任意 n 的≤6方向限制
O15 未将 P6 当作 Conj5 明确不推出 Theorem7 所需的两个已覆盖端点及两条路径性质

以上均为有限图命题，无极限、概率模态、积分交换或渐近常数事项。没有含糊的“对足够大 n”，完整范围明确为 n≥2。

反例与退化情形尝试
  1. 完美 M： P6 前提为空；若只用自由点法则证明不完整。已分支使用 Fink 定理。
  2. 空 M： 任取自由点，首纤维仍自由；不需要假设方向非空，坐标集合可补足。
  3. 31 条边、仅两个洞： 邻点目标可能被覆盖，P6 精确量词允许，闭合证明成立。
  4. 首目标 u1 已覆盖： 由 P6 允许 covered targets 直接覆盖；没有暗中缩成双自由端点。
  5. 局部 M_i 完美： 在 C_i 任一顶点仍有一条非匹配边可删，无需在该纤维找自由点。
  6. n=7： 商图 Q1 无通常简单 Hamilton 圈，原文循环记号易误读。新增说明明确改用两纤维循环次序，并证明两条真实跨边不同。这是补足解释，而不是声称原 Theorem5 假。
  7. k 奇数： 若任意取奇数个纤维，最后奇偶可能失败；实际 k=2^m 且 m≥1，始终偶数，排除此候选。
  8. n=1： Q1 没有简单 Hamilton 圈；结论严格从 n≥2 开始，未纳入该反例。
  9. n>6 且用七个方向： 不满足 D6/U6 假设，不得当作已解决的完整 RS。
  10. 任意两个已覆盖端点： P6 无此覆盖范围，不得代替 Conj5。未找到本文实际声明范围内的反例；反例搜索不是证明替代品。
范围及来源陷阱

本地论文标题含 five directions，与新推导的 six directions 不是同一项原文公开定理。作者是 Fink–Hotmar；Wang–Wang 是其引用的有大小限制的旧定理作者。来源编号固定为 arXiv:2501.19029v1；不能混入后来版本的标题、作者或编号，也不把所读 v1 的历史开放性视作今天的文献现状。

新增结论导入 P6、Fink 完美匹配定理与五方向 Theorem4。不重证这些输入，不认证新颖性，不认证发表/同行审查，不证明任意维数全部 RS，不证明任意端点六方向路径完整分类，不证明任意完全图原匹配版本。

Verdict and exact scope

PASS, relative to the declared certified Q4 inputs. No missing mathematical assumption or open proof obligation was found in the stated first-orbit theorem. For every matching of the complete graph on Q5 with holes exactly {0,3,5,6,8,15,16,23,25,26}, a simple cycle on exactly Q5 minus 0 contains the matching and uses only short additional edges. Required edges may be long or join vertices of the same parity. Coordinate permutations prove exactly the stated orbit of 30 marked normalized geometries.

This review proves neither full A10 nor Q6 P6. No full Q5 A8 theorem is an input. Its contemporaneous audit is unnecessary here. Assumptions and dependency ledger

The acyclic dependency graph is: Q4 GQ4-avoid + Q4 T15 exact classification -> the two-bridge sufficient rule -> failure constraints for six choices -> two closed eight-sets -> impossible odd covered intersection -> first marked orbit, then coordinate transport.

The Q4 statements were read directly in Q4_GENERAL_AUGMENTATION.md and Q4_T15_CLASSIFICATION.md. This is a relative review of these imports, not a rerun of all transitive Q4 certificates. No A8 global closure, Q5 A10 theorem, or P6 conclusion occurs in the dependency graph.

The complete quantified claim is: for every matching F with precisely H as its uncovered set, there exists a simple 31-cycle K with vertex set V-H0, where H0={0}, F subset E(K), and every edge of E(K)-F has Hamming distance one. For each coordinate permutation the same quantifiers hold with the transported H and unchanged forbidden vertex 0. There is no restriction on the crossing count, on the parity of required-edge endpoints, or on whether a selected bridge mirror is a crossing port.

Symbols are consistent: F_A,F_B,C partition F; X_A,X_B are endpoint sets of C; T is a set of A vertices; P,J,D,Q are matchings on T with D perfect; L is the compressed matching on B. Here Q is the endpoint matching called S in earlier bridge material. A terminal means the B endpoint of a component meeting T, with its unique T root; unrelated F_B endpoints are not such terminals. All contracted cycle statements use labelled multigraph edges.

Independent reconstruction of the decisive steps

At lines 94--108, let r be the number of rooted terminals. Their count is even because r=|T|-2|P|. If p,q are both rooted terminals and there is another terminal, r>=3 and hence r>=4. Otherwise the one outside terminal already forces r>=2. Thus in both cases r>2e, where e records whether the extra root edge was prescribed. Consequently J extends to D with at least one D edge outside J. Equality |J|=d is never used as a successful case.

Deleting D from K produces paths, including any length-one paths. Their endpoint matching Q and D make a single alternating multigraph cycle. Restoring a proper subset of the D edges cannot form a cycle. This includes d=1: coincident Q and D endpoint pairs are two labelled parallel edges; retaining both would be a two-edge cycle. This convention also handles a root prescription whose endpoints are already joined by a Q edge.

In the attached graph, a closed component would contract to a cycle of Q+P, excluded by Q+J being a forest. Original B--B components not meeting T are single original F_B edges: any longer path would need an internal selected mirror, whose bridge leads to an A leaf. Thus p,q can become a compressed pair only through their original edge, explicitly excluded, or through their distinct rooted components. The second alternative would join their roots in Q+P and form a cycle upon adding the prescribed root edge in J. This excludes precisely the T15 obstruction, including long compressed edges. Expansion preserves every original crossing edge even when its A endpoint is unrelated to a mirror endpoint.

At lines 138--175 the global no-cycle hypothesis applies to every bridge pair. For a nonfixed pair, a crossing port outside M is a rooted terminal outside {p,q}; an internal partner outside M of a selected mirror is also such a terminal. Therefore the port restriction follows from any one nonfixed pair and the internal-partner restriction follows separately for each candidate selected in a nonfixed pair. For a fixed candidate x, the three complementary obstruction edges lie on the other three candidates, so at most one belongs to F_B. At least two nonfixed choices select x. This proves the needed coverage even if F_B contains two disjoint edges inside M; it never assumes at most one fixed obstruction overall.

Every covered vertex of B outside M consequently has its mate in that same set: it cannot cross, and cannot pair to M. Apply this to both cuts:

Cut Candidate neighbors M Closed covered set
b=8, singleton 15 11,13,14,31 9,10,12,24,27,28,29,30
b=16, singleton 23 19,21,22,31 17,18,20,24,27,28,29,30

Their intersection is {24,27,28,29,30}. It contains no hole. If both sets are closed under the original matching, so is the intersection. The mate map on it is a fixed-point-free involution, which partitions it into pairs. Five vertices cannot admit that partition. This is an analytic contradiction for every original F, not an inference from unsuccessful Hamilton search.

As a finite supplement to the analytic forest argument, it fixes canonical D and generates every perfect Q on 2d labelled vertices for 1<=d<=6, retaining all single alternating Q+D cycles. It checks every proper subset J of D with a union-find forest test that detects parallel-edge cycles.

Final A10 orbit: independent universal-proof review

2026-11-01. Reviewer /root/a10_final_rank_review; user-selected gpt-6.1-sol / high. ARIS proof-checker; same-family / provisional.

PASS, relative to the explicit published matching-connectivity rank theorem. Every arbitrary eleven-edge matching whose uncovered set is H={0,1,2,4,8,15,23,27,29,30} has a simple cycle on exactly Q5−0 containing the matching, with all other edges short. The five coordinate images pass. Neither the completeness of the 17496-record spectrum nor any enumeration of original matching inputs is a premise of this acceptance.

Primary import and exact domain

I independently opened the author repository manuscript and checked its abstract/introduction (PDF pages 1,3), Theorem 3.4 and Corollary 3.5 (PDF page 9). The repository cover identifies the publication as Cygan–Kratsch–Nederlof, JACM 65(3), Article 12 (2018), DOI 10.1145/3148227.

The full matrix indexes every perfect matching of the complete graph on an even number t of labelled vertices; it does not impose bipartiteness, parity or cube adjacency. The displayed corollary gives GF(2) rank 2^(t/2−1). Its proof explicitly factors the full matrix through 2^(t/2−1) columns. For t=22 this supplies exactly the upper bound 1024 needed here. Relabelling the covered vertex set by 0,...,21 preserves the matrix. The separate real-rank result for a bipartite restriction mentioned in the introduction is not the imported result. Online text extraction confirmed the displayed formula; the screenshot request returned a cache error and was not used as evidence. This is a declared theorem import, not a claim to have newly proved its technical appendix.

Independent deterministic checks

New A10_ORBIT3_UNIVERSAL_REVIEW_check.py imports or executes no producer code. It independently checks all 1024 selected forests: twenty distinct short edges, no vertex 0, degree one at each of the 22 covered vertices, degree two at each of the nine included holes, acyclicity by DSU, and eleven components each with exactly two endpoints. Component endpoint pairings equal their stored matching records. Every selected record also matches its indexed source record. Each of the 1024 columns is a valid perfect matching on the exact covered set.

All 1,048,576 matching-connectivity bits are recomputed by unioning both matchings in DSU and counting components, independently of the producer's alternating-walk routine. Every bit equals the saved matrix; it contains 158674 ones. Column-first Gaussian elimination using Python integers, row swaps and elimination below each lowest-column pivot gives exact GF(2) rank 1024. The producer's saved pivots, combinations, basis construction and elimination implementation are not used for this rank. All manifest byte counts and SHA256 values pass, as do all hashes in the spectrum FROZEN file. The latter binds context without accepting its full-spectrum exhaustion claim. New evidence and input hashes are pinned in the adjacent review JSON.

I specifically tested the possible failure modes of a disconnected degree-two union, doubled matching pairs, a direct forest edge already required by F, a compressed hole pair equal to F, a cycle component hidden inside S, rank computed in the wrong field, a bipartite-only rank import, and independence restricted to columns being mistaken for spanning without a full-matrix upper bound.
