Input and exact statement

Primary input: A4_SPANNING_FACTOR.md, SHA256 08b78af7f4388089c6e3329b2f95dc3d538551447af17aa97baf9fa85207edc9.

For every matching F of the complete graph on V(Q5), whose four uncovered vertices have parity split 1+3, and for every choice v among the three majority-parity holes, there exists a simple 2-regular spanning graph on V(Q5) minus v containing F, with every added edge a cube edge. F has 14 edges. Arbitrary long and same-parity edges of F are permitted.

N14 is an explicit imported theorem for the adjacent branch. Its local statement and application were checked in TWO_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md; this audit does not independently re-prove the external Fink–Mütze Theorem 8 on which N14 rests. The final bibliographical source-comparison paragraph of the factor document is not part of the audited theorem or its dependency chain.

Obligation ledger
ID Obligation and independent verification Result
O1 XOR by the minority hole maps that hole to 0 and the other three to odd vertices; preserves every short edge and matching incidence. Closed
O2 If ab or at is short, adjoining it gives a matching with exactly two odd holes, including v. N14 at dimension 5 produces the required cycle; the adjoined edge is short relative to original F. Closed modulo N14
O3 Otherwise r(a)=r(b)=r(t)=2 and r=1 elsewhere; even demand 15+2=17, odd demand 13+2+2=17. Closed
O4 A lost odd neighbor other than v must have exactly one neighbor in S because F contains at most one edge incident to it. Its partner cannot be a. Distinct lost neighbors have distinct partners. Thus losses are bounded by R(S), including when some F edges are long. Closed
O5 Both b and t retain all incident cube edges, and at most 16-n(S) of them are outside the full neighborhood. Their extra demand contributes at least max(0,n(S)-14). Removing v costs at most one. Closed
O6 GF5 holds for all 65,535 nonempty subsets of the 16 even vertices, by independent exhaustive integer computation. Empty clone subsets satisfy 0<=0 directly. Closed by finite computation
O7 For any subset U of even clones, its represented original set S has exactly the same clone neighborhood as the full set of clones of S, and size(U)<=size(S)+1[a in S]. Weighted Hall therefore covers partial-clone subsets as well. Equal sides of size 17 turn the saturating matching into a perfect matching. Closed
O8 A repeated projected edge requires both endpoints to be doubled. The only doubled vertices are a,b,t; b,t have equal parity, and ab,at are absent in this branch. No duplicate can occur. Closed
O9 H avoids every short F edge by definition of G; long F edges cannot equal a short H edge. Thus F union H is simple and degree two at all 31 allowed vertices. No F edge meets v because v is a hole. Closed
O10 Every finite simple graph of degree two is a disjoint union of cycles; this yields exactly the claimed scope and does not imply connectivity. Closed
O11 CF1: for nonempty proper clone subsets, proper original support has at least one unit of excess by GF5's table; full support has all 17 odd neighbors and at most 16 clones. Thus strict Hall holds. Removing endpoints of any chosen clone edge leaves Hall, so that edge lies in a perfect matching and its original edge lies in a spanning factor. Closed

Dependency graph is acyclic: normalization and the adjacent-case import are independent of GF5; GF5 plus the loss estimate yields clone Hall, then simple projection, then the cycle factor. A4 or P6 is not used anywhere.

CF1 uses the strict version of the same Hall bound and the same projection argument. It permits prescribing one allowed new edge in the nonadjacent branch. Removing two selected endpoints costs at most one neighbor for any subset of the remaining even part; that subset was a proper subset of the original 17-vertex part. Equal remaining sides of size 16 allow Hall again. There is no inference to simultaneous prescription of several edges or to keeping a previously chosen component while joining another one.

Independent computational verification

The submitted checker verify_a4_factor_geometry.py was read and rerun. Its 65,535 nonempty masks cover every relevant S, and its leaf-parent bitset counts distinct parents rather than leaf edges. It returns PASS with the stated minima.

An independent checker, a4_factor_gray_audit.py, instead visits all subsets in Gray-code order, updates the five affected odd degrees, and tracks the XOR of selected original vertex labels at each odd vertex. At degree one this XOR is the unique parent. It does not reuse the submitted neighbor-mask loop. The empty case is handled separately and is included only to give 65,536 total Hall cases. Results are in a4_factor_gray_audit_results.json.

For sizes 0 through 16 both independent and submitted checks agree on:

[0,2,3,3,2,2,1,1,1,3,4,3,3,3,2,1,0].

The submitted result uses null at size zero because GF5 is only asserted for nonempty S. This is a presentation difference: Hall itself has slack zero for the empty subset. The independent histogram has exactly two zero-slack sets, the empty set and the entire even part. No negative slack exists. Each nonempty cardinality has a concrete minimizing witness in both results.

The larger C++ checker was also inspected: its eligible b,t values are the 11 odd nonneighbors of 0, chosen unordered in 55 ways, and v is any of the remaining 14 odd vertices. This gives 770 configurations. It loops all 65,536 subsets and correctly counts protected leaf parents. Its 50,462,720-case reported result agrees with the stronger, hole-independent GF5 check. This review did not independently rerun those 50 million cases because GF5 alone already suffices and was independently verified.

Counterexample pass and boundaries

The following failure mechanisms were explicitly tested against the proof:

  • Long or same-parity F edges: they remove no extra short edges, so they cannot invalidate the loss bound.
  • Several leaf neighbors of one parent: F removes at most one of them; counting distinct parents is the correct upper bound.
  • A subset containing only one clone of a: identical clone neighborhoods make Hall valid without requiring such subsets to be unions of clone pairs.
  • Projecting a generic demand-clone matching can create parallel edges if an edge joins two doubled endpoints. The proof explicitly excludes exactly those a-b and a-t edges before using this projection; the adjacent branch is handled by N14 instead.
  • S empty or all even vertices: both have Hall equality and are handled.
  • A disconnected factor: this remains possible. No merging procedure or connected-factor claim is inferred from the Hall calculation.

No non-enumerative derivation of GF5 was obtained in this audit. GF5 remains a complete finite computer-assisted lemma rather than an asymptotic or experimental assertion. The universal conclusion quantifies over all F by the analytic loss estimate; it does not enumerate only sampled matchings.

No proof text or root state file was modified by this audit. Deterministic verification closes GF5; same-family reviewer agreement alone is not a cross-family semantic acceptance overlay.

Definitions and global invariants

E/O denote global minority/majority parity, not local parity coordinates in each face. Every coordinate identification with Q4 preserves equality and opposition of parity, which is sufficient for every imported theorem. The mirror bar(t) is the short neighbor across the cut and is never silently identified with the required partner. Ports are covered by original crossing edges and cannot be original holes or internal-matching endpoints.

All artificial edges are temporary matching edges. Every one is deleted, suppressed, or expanded. The interiors expanded in the final B cycle are pairwise disjoint, and absent from that B cycle. In particular a bridge vertex that becomes an interior is explicitly avoided on the B side. Original crossing edges can be long; they are retained required edges. All genuinely new bridges and optional edges are short. These facts establish both simplicity and the required-edge/new-edge distinction of the final cycle.

Deleting a nonempty matching D from a simple cycle produces a path forest. Restoring a proper subset of D by pairwise internally disjoint replacement paths preserves a path forest: contraction yields a proper subgraph of the original cycle. If xy is one deleted D edge and at least one other D edge is deleted, x and y lie in different resulting components. These are exactly the separation facts used in the port cases. For a spanning path, deleting any nonempty set of its edges separates its two original endpoints.

Two delicate steps checked in detail

For double suppression, F_B+R should be viewed as a multigraph with the two edge sources retained. Every vertex besides the internal bridge vertices has degree at most one. Thus a cycle requires both internal bridge vertices, and with only those two degree2 vertices it must be a parallel two-edge component. When w-z is not an F_B edge there is no such component. When w-z is an F_B edge, c>=2 and ts belongs to D, so deleting another D edge separates t,s; the attachments therefore cannot produce R edge w-z. Each remaining component has two distinct degree1 endpoints and can be compressed to an ordinary matching edge. This also proves that suppressing two adjacent internal bridge vertices creates no loop or repeated endpoint. T44 is applied only after this check, with exactly the four advertised same-parity holes.

For the all-zero exception, set S={x: popcount(x>>2)<=1}. If x in S and r outside S are joined by a matching edge, some j in {2,3,4} has r_j=1,x_j=0: otherwise the support of r in these bits would be contained in that of x. In a bad cut with c_j=0 such an edge is forbidden. In the other bad form the B endpoint r has to be 2^j or 2^j+3, both inside S. This contradiction is independent of the length of xr. The set has 16 vertices and exactly holes 0,1,3. Therefore 13 covered vertices would all have mates inside S, which is impossible. The paired-edge condition of the c_j=0 form is not even needed for this final barrier argument; its zero-crossing condition suffices.

The checker also verifies the exceptional face holes and bridge coverage, computes S and its three holes, and examines all 13*13=169 covered vertex pairs across its boundary. Every one violates a bad-cut B-port restriction even when zero-crossing cuts are relaxed to allow both designated ports. This is a finite check of the barrier implication, not a search over matchings.

Adversarial edge cases checked mathematically include: c=0 in delta2 and in double bridge; c=1 in both odd branches; c=2 with both bridges ports; the w-z required internal edge; R and F_B parallel edges; the c=1 root of either parity; the new mirror being either a hole or internally matched; arbitrary same-parity crossings; and both all-zero exceptions. Consequences after discharging the A6 assumption

At the parent's explicit request, this review also read the previously PASS EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW.md/.json and its reviewed draft. The independent checker now verifies all of that report's audited-input, imported-dependency, and checker-artifact hashes. All agree. The earlier conditional audit covers 2588364 free-target hole geometries, including its 61 configurations requiring the root-bridge boundary construction. Those checks are imported here, not falsely reported as having been rerun here.

The local endpoint consequence (called G6-local here) has the following precise statement. For every arbitrary matching F of K(Q5) with 2t holes, 1<=t<=3, let h be its even-minus-odd hole count. If h is -2,0,2, r is a hole, y!=r, and epsilon(r)+epsilon(y)=h, there is a Hamilton r--y path containing F and adding only short edges. This is Section 1 of the conditional reduction. The label distinguishes it from the already existing G6 geometry classification in SIX_HOLE_MIXED_AND_GEOMETRY.md.

For completeness the direct proof is short. If y is free, adjoin ry: the remaining 0,2,4 holes are balanced, and perfect matching/N10/K4 supplies a full cycle, which can be opened at ry. If y is covered with mate k, replace yk by kr. The holes replace r by y, so their count is still 2t and imbalance is h-epsilon(r)+epsilon(y)=2epsilon(y). N14/A4/now-proved A6 supplies a cycle omitting exactly y. Delete kr and append original ky. All artificial edges are removed; y is restored once. This verifies the full root/target quantifiers, including covered targets and arbitrary same-parity required edges.

K6 follows: every balanced six-hole arbitrary K(Q5) matching has a Hamilton path from each free root to every opposite-parity target, free or covered. It also has a full extending cycle, obtained by choosing a short neighbor of the free root as target and closing the path. These are universal local lemmas, relative to the same explicit earlier inputs, rather than sampled claims.

The just-audited A6 exactly matches the new universal assumption of the conditional reduction, including arbitrary complete-graph matching edges and each specified majority-hole avoidance. Substitution therefore proves the complete Q6 eight-hole FREE-target endpoint theorem: for every 28-edge short matching M in Q6 and each two distinct free vertices u,v of opposite parity, there is a Hamilton u--v path containing M. It also proves all covered targets satisfying that reduction's preliminary augmentation or nine-row cut criterion. No stronger consequence is inferred from the previous PASS.

The full eight-hole endpoint theorem still requires R8-covered. Its explicit all-six-directions short-matching witness survives, so this is a nonempty remaining domain for the present scheme. Full P6 and the 10,12,14,16,18 hole levels remain open. These consequences add no proof dependency cycle: A6 was proved from Q4 inputs and Q5 A4 before it was substituted downstream. Their semantic assurance is the same same-family/provisional assurance.

Review date: 2026-11-01. Requested reviewer: GPT-6.1-sol, high. review_independence: same-family; acceptance_status: provisional.

Result: the two finite inputs pass independent deterministic verification, including complete arbitrary matching coverage and the required geometric orbit coverage. The old two-hole spectrum dependencies were also reverified. This report does not establish A6 or P6, and does not change their status.

The machine-readable evidence is A6_FINITE_INPUTS_REVIEW.json. The independent checker is a6_finite_inputs_independent_check.py. All paths here are relative to this report's directory. Existing producers, certificates, checkers and main proof state were left untouched. The existing producer PASS logs were not used as evidence for validity or completeness.

Precise statements audited

Write Q4 on vertices 0,...,15 with short edges joining vertices whose XOR has Hamming weight one. KQ4 here means the complete graph on these vertices: the prescribed matching can contain arbitrary long or same-parity edges. Four distinct holes mean exactly the unmatched vertices, so the matching has six edges. All paths and cycles below contain every prescribed matching edge.

  1. For every matching with holes {v,b,z,d}, with v,b of one parity, z,d of the other parity, and z not adjacent to b, there is a simple 15-vertex path covering exactly Q4 minus v, starting at d and ending at a vertex e with parity(e)=parity(d) and e != z. Every edge outside the matching is short.
  2. For every four-hole matching with a 1:3 parity split, and for each specified hole h in the majority class, consider all simple cycles covering exactly Q4 minus h with every new edge short. The union of their new edges contains at least 15 distinct short edges. For a 2:2 split, take cycles covering all 16 vertices; the analogous union contains at least 18 short edges.

The second statement is a spectrum/union bound. It does not say that a single cycle has 15 or 18 new edges. In the four-hole setting each such cycle has respectively nine or ten new edges, so that reading would be false. Likewise, a witnessed minimum union of 15/18 need not be the exact full spectrum.

Independent verification method

The checker imports no producer or supplied-checker code. It reconstructs matchings as unordered pair partitions. A separate recursive enumerator builds the entire expected set on the covered vertex set, and the set of parsed matchings must equal that expected set, with duplicates forbidden. This avoids reusing the supplied checkers' mixed-radix rank mechanism. It independently confirms 12-vertex matching counts 11!!=10395 and 14-vertex counts 13!!=135135.

For each record it checks exact holes, no fixed points, a symmetric matching involution, distinct path/cycle vertices and exact required vertex set, inclusion of all six (or seven for old two-hole inputs) matching edges, and Hamming distance one for every remaining edge. Paths additionally satisfy the prescribed root and endpoint restrictions. Cycles explicitly include the closing edge. Each spectrum union is reconstructed from actual edges with the matching edges removed, record by record. Parsing must consume the file exactly, and counts and full matching sets must agree.

It constructs all 16*24=384 cube automorphisms explicitly and checks adjacency preservation. Coordinate permutations fix 0; translations reduce any v to 0 and preserve parity equality/opposition as well as short edges. Relabeling also preserves arbitrary complete-graph matching edges.

Path input and orbit cover

After translating v to 0 there are 196 eligible ordered triples (b,z,d): seven nonzero even b, four odd z at distance three from b, and seven distinct odd choices of d. Their 13 orbits under the 24 coordinate permutations have the following representatives and multiplicities:

Both q4_balanced_avoid_path_configs.txt and every entry and multiplicity in q4_balanced_avoid_path_orbits.json agree with the independently computed orbits. Every representative file covers all 10395 matchings and supplies one valid path per matching: 135135 path records total. By equivariance, these witnesses establish statement 1 for every allowed configuration.

Four-hole spectrum orbit cover and adjacent-hole reduction

Let M have holes H and let e=ab be a short edge joining two holes. Then M'=M union {e} is an arbitrary matching with two holes. Any legal completion of M' is a legal completion of M with the same avoided vertex, if any: it contains M, and its newly added edges relative to M are the new edges relative to M' together with e. Consequently the old spectrum is a subset of the spectrum for M; no distinct optional edges are lost in this reduction.

For the 1:3 case, fix the avoided majority hole h. If the minority hole has a short edge to either of the other two majority holes, choose it as e. The two remaining holes are h and another majority vertex, at distance two or four. The old L15 two-hole result applies, avoiding exactly h. Translation maps h to 0, and coordinate permutation maps the other hole to 3 or 15, respectively. Its seven-edge matching is arbitrary, as required by the old certificates.

If no such e exists, normalize the minority hole to 0. The other two majority holes are distinct weight-three vertices, and coordinate permutation carries their unordered pair to {7,11}. The three residual marked-hole orbits have representatives (H,h)=({0,7,11,t},t) with t=1,4,13. Explicit complete automorphism enumeration verifies this classification, including both choices of majority parity: there are 2688 marked configurations in total, 2112 handled by the adjacent reduction and 576 residual configurations, exactly 192 in each of the three orbits. The residual condition concerns adjacency between the minority hole and the other two majority holes; adjacency to the avoided hole does not permit the old avoided-hole reduction.

For the 2:2 case, any short hole-hole edge e leaves two opposite-parity holes, at distance one or three. The old L18 two-hole result applies after translation and coordinate permutation to the representative other hole 1 or 7. Among all binomial(8,2)^2=784 balanced four-hole sets, 760 admit this reduction. The remaining 24 sets form exactly the automorphism orbit of {0,3,13,14}. The independent enumeration checks equality with that orbit, rather than only checking a list of selected examples.

For each positive record the checker verifies 13 distinct vertices equal to Q4 minus U, the two cyclic neighbors at every vertex, preservation of every required edge, and shortness of every edge outside the required matching. This discharges the WLOG and quantifier obligations for every arbitrary matching and every marked U.

Bridge graph, compression, and obstruction control

For k=2 or 3 bridges let W be their distinct B mirrors. The added bridges are new short edges: their A endpoints are distinct original holes. They cannot duplicate edges of the original matching, even when a mirror is a crossing port. Every vertex of T has degree one in G; each mirror has degree two (one original required edge and its bridge); all other covered B vertices have degree one. Original B holes are isolated. A cycle of G would have to pass through a mirror, hence through its adjacent A leaf, which is impossible. This proof does not assume original crossings are short, that the two mirrors are unpaired, or that mirrors are internal rather than ports.

A nontrivial G component has either two T endpoints, one T endpoint and one B terminal, or two B endpoints. The first components define a matching P on T; each contains a mirror, so |P|<=k. Terminal components have unique, distinct roots, disjoint from endpoints of P. A two-B-endpoint component is a single edge of F_B: a longer path would require an internal mirror, whose bridge goes to an A leaf. This also settles the case where both potential obstruction endpoints lie in the same G component: then their edge is already an original F_B edge and is excluded by the fixed-edge condition. Roots are never ambiguously assigned to a component with two terminals and a T endpoint.

Since J is a matching on T, it extends to a perfect matching D. The strict inequality d>|J| makes J a proper subset. Delete D from the GQ4-avoid cycle K on A-v. Since D is a nonempty matching, all remaining components are nonempty paths with endpoint set T; their contraction is S. S+D is one alternating cycle, including the parallel-edge d=1 case. Restoring any proper subset of its D edges cannot create a cycle. Hence S+J, and in particular S+P, are forests.

Expanding S and attaching G therefore produces disjoint paths with endpoints precisely the covered nonmirror vertices of B. Every A-v vertex and every mirror is an interior vertex of exactly one such path; every required edge belongs to exactly one path (or is a single-edge path). Compression gives a genuine loop-free matching L. Its holes are exactly H_B union W. There are no duplicated endpoints, lost components, or suppressed original holes.

If two covered candidate obstruction endpoints are both terminals, their distinct roots u,r are unused by P. Adding ur to J is therefore legal. If compression paired those endpoints, S+P would contain a u--r path. Together with the separately labelled ur edge it would form a cycle in S+J, contradicting the proper-subset argument. This remains valid if the path is one edge, when the forbidden cycle has two parallel edges. If one endpoint is not a terminal, its component is a single original F_B edge, so excluding the fixed obstruction suffices. These are all possibilities; original edges may be arbitrary long edges.

The final B cycle contains L and omits exactly W. Replace each compressed edge by its stored path, including single-edge paths when appropriate. The paths have disjoint interiors and endpoints, and the omitted mirrors occur only inside them. Thus the result is one simple cycle with exactly Q5-v as vertex set, containing all F_A,F_B,C. Artificial D edges have been removed, compressed edges have been expanded, original long edges are retained, and every other introduced edge is short.

Double-bridge hypothesis discharge

The hypotheses imply |H_B|=4 and |H_A|=4. The two mirrors have the same parity by assumption 3; t,s have the opposite parity. If t,s are minority holes, the A counts are (majority,minority)=(2,2), hence delta=0. If t,s are majority holes, the counts are (4,0), hence delta=4. In both cases removing t,s leaves precisely two majority holes including v. Consequently F_A+D satisfies GQ4-avoid, c is even, and d=(c+2)/2. This T15 criterion does not assert all possible delta-four cuts have its 1+5 B-hole pattern.

The singleton B hole a is original: mirrors belong to the five-hole parity class. If both mirrors neighbor a, its other neighbors p,q are not original holes. They have the mirrors' parity; residual (I) excludes their being original holes, since a is in B and therefore is not v. They are also distinct from the mirrors. Q4 T15's obstruction is exactly pq in L. If a mirror is not adjacent to a, the obstruction is already geometrically impossible. Otherwise pq not in F_B is explicitly required; it cannot be dropped even for large c. The root-pair argument above excludes newly compressed pq. All T15 hypotheses are now discharged. Here |P|<=2, |J|<=3, so c>=6 implies d>=4>|J|, subject to the fixed-edge condition. Smaller c are included whenever the actual strict criterion holds; no claim is made when it fails.

Three-bridge hypothesis discharge and fourth-orbit boundary

For delta=-1 as stated, A has two majority and three minority holes; B has three majority holes. Each minority bridge mirror has majority parity and is covered by residual (I). Then c is odd, d=(c+3)/2, and F_A+D has exactly the two majority holes in A, including v. The GQ4-avoid application is valid. L has six majority holes, with W the three avoided holes, so T63 applies.

An opposite-parity vertex has a unique remaining neighbor outside W exactly when it neighbors all three mirrors. There is at most one such vertex: two distinct Q4 vertices have at most two common neighbors. If it exists, a is a covered nonmirror vertex; its fourth neighbor b is not a mirror. If b is an original hole, ab cannot lie in L. Otherwise both endpoints are covered nonmirror vertices, the explicit fixed-edge exclusion and root-pair argument eliminate ab. Thus every possible T63 obstruction, including one introduced by compression, is excluded. Here |J|<=4; c>=7 yields d>=5>|J| whenever the required original-edge exclusion holds. The criterion also covers any smaller-c instance that actually satisfies the strict inequality.

The independent checker verifies the fourth residual geometry directly: at bit 8 the mirrors are 9,10,12 with a=8,b=24; at bit 16 they are 17,18,20 with a=16,b=24. Both A faces have the stated 2+3 hole counts. The two fixed edges 8--24 and 16--24 cannot both belong to a matching. Therefore at least one cut has no fixed obstruction. If such a cut has c>=7, the theorem applies. If both sufficient tests fail, at least one cut has no fixed obstruction and c<=5 (c is odd). This does not imply the other cut has no fixed obstruction, or that the small-c cut satisfies d>|J|, or that the full orbit is closed. Those cases remain OPEN.

Adversarial edge cases and reproduction

Checked structurally: arbitrary long original edges; mirror ports; two mirrors paired by an original edge; obstruction endpoints in one G component; obstruction endpoints in distinct terminal components; an obstruction endpoint that is an original hole; no common neighbor; d=1 and parallel contracted edges; and equality |J|=d. No counterexample to a stated criterion was found. Equality was deliberately not accepted: restoring all deleted edges can close a component. A fixed original obstruction edge cannot be removed through root prescriptions.

Exact theorem and imports

Let F be any matching on the32 Q5 vertices with three minority and five majority holes, and let v be any specified majority hole. Suppose no minority hole is short-adjacent to a majority hole other than v. Suppose a coordinate face A containing v contains all five majority holes and exactly one minority hole. Then a simple cycle on exactly Q5−v contains every edge of F and has only short edges outside F. All required edges may be long or same-parity.

The nonadjacency hypothesis is the after-augmentation hypothesis. It does not prohibit adjacency to v, and does not restrict F's required edges. GQ4-avoid is read in Q4_GENERAL_AUGMENTATION.md and accepted in the final A6 audit; it applies to all imbalance-two hole counts and arbitrary required edges. Q4 T44 is the explicit four-same-parity-hole, any-two-prescribed- omissions theorem in Q4_TWO_AVOIDED_TRANSFER.md, with its accepted whole matching-quantifier review. The earlier exhaustive matching certificates are imported rather than rerun. Thirteen relevant recorded hashes match current sources/reports. No Q5 T15, Q4 T15, unrestricted A8, or double-bridge theorem under investigation is imported.

The dependency DAG is Q4 N14/A4 and the already accepted local consequences → GQ4-avoid; separately certified Q4 T44 → B completion. These plus the new two-bridge forest proof imply this geometric branch. The partial-A8 review is used only to identify and combine the disjoint residual sets, not to establish the new two-bridge transfer itself.

Four-cut hypotheses and exact Q4 obstruction identities

All holes have the required 5-even/3-odd pattern. Each nonzero even hole 15,23,27,29 has no short edge to any of 1,2,4, so the residual nonadjacency hypothesis holds. Face A is the zero face and always contains 0. The following facts were independently derived rather than accepted from the typed signatures:

For bits 2 and 4, A has two majority and two minority holes. Removing the two chosen minority sources leaves two majority holes including 0. B has one minority and three majority original holes; the two covered mirrors produce the required 1+5 T15 pattern. The singleton's four in-face neighbors are exactly the two omitted mirrors and the displayed pair. For bits 8 and 16, A has two majority and three minority holes; deleting the three sources again leaves two majority holes including 0. B has three majority holes and the covered mirrors make the T63 six-hole pattern. The displayed common neighbor is unique and its fourth neighbor is 24. Coverage necessity without the diagnostic spectrum

Fix a template and suppose its fixed obstruction edge pq is absent from the original matching. Put S=Y union {p,q}. If an original crossing edge has its B endpoint outside S, that endpoint is a covered nonmirror degree-one vertex of G and is a terminal rooted in T. If an internal mirror's original mate lies outside S, that mate is a covered nonmirror degree-one vertex of G, again a terminal rooted through the mirror's bridge. In either case it is a terminal outside {p,q}. This uses no assumption that an original edge is short.

The graph lemma gives R=|T|-2|P| rooted terminals. Here |T| is even: the two double-bridge cuts have even c and |T|=c+2, while the triple-bridge cuts have odd c and |T|=c+3. Thus R is even. Let e be 1 if both p and q are rooted terminals, and 0 otherwise. For e=0 the additional terminal gives R>=2>0; for e=1 it gives R>=4>2. Consequently |T|/2>|P|+e, exactly the audited strict sufficient criterion. The root edge, when needed, is a matching edge disjoint from P. The original fixed edge is absent by the explicit premise, so its exclusion hypothesis also holds. Therefore violation of either restricted condition proves this matching extendable by that template.

Taking the contrapositive for all four templates proves that every input not already covered satisfies each required restricted condition unless its fixed edge is present. This is a necessary coverage condition only; no converse is needed. In particular the restricted finite family may contain inputs also solvable by a template. Certifying the entire family still completes the proof. No Hamilton-search failure or diagnostic classification is used to infer coverage.

Exact 16-domain enumeration and empty-domain certificates

An input's mask is determined uniquely by which four actual fixed edges it contains. For a set bit its edge is required. For an unset bit that edge is explicitly forbidden, crossing B endpoints must lie in S, and internal B edges meeting Y must remain inside S. All other edges are allowed, including long and same-parity edges. These are exactly the graph conditions used by the independent reconstruction. Every required edge is also checked against all other applicable restrictions before its endpoints are removed. Domains cannot overlap because their actual fixed edge masks differ.

Masks 12,13,14,15 require both 8--24 and 16--24, contradicting that F is a matching. For every other empty branch the rebuilt residual graph has an odd connected component with no allowed outgoing edge. A perfect matching would have to match that odd component internally, which is impossible. One small explicit component per empty branch is:

The other three domains are independently enumerated by taking the least remaining vertex, pairing it with each allowed remaining neighbor and recursing. CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW.md — Independent audit of canonical A4 completion and gluing

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：af7614bc4e2ce455129e7faab700360349c5e0b9540e4c9ef23568c5d6d5b49b。

Independent audit of canonical A4 completion and gluing

Date: 2026-11-01. Reviewer requested: GPT-6.1-sol, high reasoning. Review independence: same-family; semantic acceptance: provisional. Final submission CANONICAL_A4_CLOSURE.md was read in full and checked line by line. Deterministic finite checks: PASS. Mathematical gluing: PASS modulo the explicit imported Q4 and hole-geometry results below. This does not prove the full P6 statement at the 8--18-hole levels.

Scope and independence

The new self-contained checker CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW_check.py imports no generator, primary checker, or stored exception JSON. It reads the two binary tables directly. It validates every positive cycle, proves matching coverage by unique valid involutions and exact cardinality, and independently enumerates all short complementary perfect matchings for each negative. It then scans all 2027025 near-perfect A-side inputs forward, and enumerates all completions of every candidate stalled partial forward. Thus the decisive universal endpoint property is checked without using the producer's inverse-enumeration reasoning.

The checker completed successfully; its detailed output is CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW_check.json.

Explicit statement and symbols

Canonical input: an arbitrary complete-graph matching F on Q5, with holes {0,1,14,22}; the desired simple circle covers every vertex except 1, contains F, and uses only cube edges outside F. Cut the least significant coordinate. Local labels x represent 2x+1 in A and 2x in B. Thus A has hole 0 and B has holes 0,7,11. Write X_A,X_B for distinct crossing-port sets and c for their common size. F_A,F_B are disjoint internal matchings. Counting gives 2|F_A|+c=15, so c is positive odd.

For d in X_A, D pairs X_A minus d, and L=F_A+D has holes 0,d. For an odd y different from d, put k=L(y) and T_y=L-yk+dk, a matching with holes 0,y. A 14-cycle extending T_y avoids both holes. Delete dk and append ky to obtain a spanning d--y path P in A minus 0 containing L. The auxiliary edge dk cannot already be another edge of L: d was free. Deleting its occurrence in the simple cycle yields a simple path, and y was absent, so appending it introduces no repetition. This proves exactly the path property used below.

The submission additionally asserts the converse. It is correct: since y is an endpoint of a path containing L, its unique incident path edge must be its prescribed L-edge yk. Remove y from the path and join its remaining endpoints d,k by dk. These endpoints cannot already be adjacent in this 14-vertex simple path, so this gives a simple 14-cycle with every required edge of T_y(L), and all other edges short.

Finite obligations
  1. All 135135 matchings for holes 0,1 are covered once. There are 135084 positive witnesses and 51 negatives, of which 15 contain a half-layer and 36 do not.
  2. All 135135 matchings for holes 0,7 are covered once. There are 135082 positive witnesses and 53 negatives, of which 45 contain a half-layer and 8 do not.
  3. For a negative, every extending 14-cycle would be F plus a disjoint short perfect matching, since F already gives degree one everywhere. The independent recursive enumeration covers all such short matchings and all resulting 2-factors have at least two components. This proves negative status rather than trusting a failed Hamilton search.
  4. Coordinate permutations take holes 0,1 or 0,7 to 0,y for every odd y. The independent checker explicitly transports the mate involutions.
  5. There are 15*13!!=2027025 near-perfect inputs (d,L). A direct forward scan finds exactly 256 for which neither y=7 nor y=11 works; the option y=d is declared unavailable, as required by the construction.
  6. A partial F_A with c ports has exactly T=c(c-2)!! completions (d,D). For every stalled near-perfect L it contains, count the occurrence of F_A as a subset. The partial stalls precisely when this count is T: each completion is unique and occurs once in the forward scan.
  7. The exact stalled-partial counts for c=1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15 are 256,210,42,2,0,0,0,0. Their completion counts T are 1,3,15,105,945,10395,135135,2027025.
  8. For c=1 the good-endpoint cardinality distribution is {4:210,5:6,6:40}; for c=3 all 210 stalls have four good odd endpoints.
  9. Every c=5 or c=7 stall has exactly four good odd endpoints G, disjoint from X_A. For each y in G, every one of its T completions works. This stronger quantifier is essential in choosing d from a B port's actual original crossing partner.
  10. The two c=7 partials are exactly H1={(2,3),(4,5),(8,9),(14,15)} and H2={(1,3),(4,6),(8,10),(13,15)}. Every c=5 partial contains exactly one of these cores. There are 21 choices of its extra edge per core.

All ten finite obligations PASS deterministically. No conclusion about Q5 counterexamples is inferred from a Q4 negative.

Every candidate-partial count in the submission's table was independently checked as well: 256,1372,3048,3596,2366,808,84,1, respectively.

Safe endpoint transfer: y outside X_B

Choose a good completion and its d--y path P. Delete D, attach every original crossing edge and the short mirror bridge y_A y_B. Every new B endpoint is in X_B union {y}, a set of c+1 distinct vertices. The result is a family of disjoint B-to-B paths whose internal vertices partition A minus 0. If y belongs to X_A, its D edge was the final edge of P, and deleting D leaves y isolated. Its original crossing edge and the new bridge give a two-edge segment through y with distinct endpoints in B; this is valid and loses no original matching edge. Other deleted D endpoints receive their original crossing edge; the root d receives its original crossing edge; an internally covered y receives its bridge. No component can close because B attachments are distinct degree-one endpoints. Compression therefore gives a matching R on X_B union {y}.

If y is 7 or 11, F_B+R has holes 0 and the other of 7,11, hence opposite parity. NC_4 gives a full B circle; expansion gives the required circle.

Otherwise y is an odd non-hole outside X_B and is internally matched by F_B. Put k=F_B(y), r=R(y). The vertices y,k,r are distinct, k is not a port and r is a port. Then L_B=(F_B-yk)+(R-yr)+kr is a matching with precisely the holes 0,7,11,y. Apply A4_4 avoiding y. Expand kr into k--y followed by the transferred y--r path, and expand all other compressed edges. This restores y, F_B's edge ky, and every A vertex other than 0 exactly once. All retained auxiliary edges are expanded; the only new crossing bridge is short.

Occupied endpoint transfer: y in X_B

This case is used only for c=5 or c=7 stalled partials. Pick y in G and take d to be the actual A endpoint of F's crossing edge incident to y_B. Because G is disjoint from X_A, y_A is internally covered by F_A, and d differs from y_A. Pair X_A minus d arbitrarily to obtain D. Universal availability in obligation 9 yields P for this d and D. Since c>=5, D is nonempty, and no D edge touches either endpoint of P. Deleting D separates d and y_A into different components: a path has a unique route between its endpoints and every D edge lies on that route.

Attach the original crossing edges and the mirror bridge y_A y_B. Only the original d--y_B crossing and the new y_A--y_B bridge share a B vertex. Their two A segments were distinct, so joining them at y_B concatenates paths instead of creating a cycle. All other B ends are the distinct vertices X_B minus {y}. Thus compression is a matching R on X_B minus {y}, and its disjoint interiors partition (A minus 0) union {y_B}. F_B+R is a matching with exactly the holes 0,7,11,y. These are distinct because X_B contains none of B's original holes. All three nonzero holes are odd. A4_4 gives a B circle avoiding y, and expanding R restores the internal y_B and all of A minus 0, proving the desired 31-vertex circle. Both edges at y_B are restored, including its original F edge. The new mirror bridge is distinct from that original edge since d differs from y_A.

Complete case partition and imports

If F_A is not stalled, choose y=7 or 11, both outside X_B, and apply the safe transfer. A stalled c=1 or c=3 partial has at least four good odd endpoints but at most three B ports, so one is outside X_B. A stalled c=5 or c=7 partial either has y in G outside X_B, handled safely, or has G contained in X_B, handled by the occupied transfer. There are no stalled partials at larger c. The partition includes all positive odd c.

Consequently the canonical A4 family is proved modulo Q4 inputs NC_4, A4_4 and the finite checks above. Importing R1A from A4_SINGLE_GEOMETRY_REDUCTION.md proves full Q5 A4, conditional only on its already specified Q5 N14, Q4, and optional-edge-spectrum imports. These imports were read as explicit inputs and were not silently replaced by an assumption of A4. There is no circular dependency: the Q4 proofs precede and do not use Q5 A4; R1A leaves this canonical case open.

The earlier full-six-hole reductions can now discharge their A4 hypothesis. Their independent acceptance is an import, not a fresh audit of every six-hole lemma here. The theorem still says nothing new about the 8--18-hole levels, so a conclusion of full P6 would remain unjustified.

The pre-gluing unresolved full-matching counts are independently confirmed as 429105120=4762800 at c=5 and 2binomial(9,3)155040=12700800 at c=7. They are unnecessary for the proof, since the occupied-endpoint construction covers these families universally without enumerating all original matchings.

Their dependency arrows run from A4 to K4 and the six-hole transfer theorems; none is invoked to prove A4 here. Thus the final consequence is a valid discharge of a previously conditional result, modulo its stated earlier theorems, with no dependency cycle.

Adversarial checks specifically considered c=1 with D empty, a target isolated by deletion of D, a long original crossing edge at the occupied target, collisions between mirror bridge and original crossing edge, and a possible closed component at the shared B port. 容易误用的细节

tag 与双冲突。 不能先把某个被覆盖镜像当作自由终点套 N10。 正确顺序是先以 uv 连接全局终端片段，再把所有片段压成 T， 然后将 Y 上的全部冲突组件同时压缩。由于 kj 被 M_B 内部匹配， 它不可能是 X_B、Y、u 或 t 中的端点；因此它在并图中度数恰为 1。 这排除了冲突组件成圈的可能。y1,y2 在 T 中配成一边时必须压缩整条四点路径， 不能分别压缩两个重叠的三点片段。正文采取的整体压缩合法。

孔数核算。 记 H_B 为原 B 孔，则最终 L 的孔集合依次为：

行 δ 最终孔集合 偶、奇孔数
(2,1) 1 H_B∪Y 1,5
(2,1) 0 (H_B{u})∪Y 1,5
(2,0) 1 (H_B{t})∪Y 1,5
(2,0) 0 (H_B{u,t})∪Y 1,5

Y 的暴露没有意外暴露 k1,k2，它们成为压缩边的端点。T15 因而真的适用于 任意由该构造产生的 L；不需要 L 二部，也不要求压缩边短。

没有偶交叉端口也能处理 (2,1),δ=0。 此时 c 为奇数且至少 1， 以自由偶孔 z1 为起点，用任意完整图配对填满 X_A∪{z2}， 留下偶 z1 与奇 w 两孔。目标 v 奇且不同于 z1，N10 条件全部满足。 要求存在偶端口会额外缩小原量词，正文没有这样做。

EP0 端点边界。 q=v 时删除 qs 可把 v 暂时变成孤立点， 其真实交叉边把它恢复成最终终点。s=u 时同理由 ut 恢复根终点。 两者均被正文接受，不能排除来简化转移。若同时 q=v、s=u， 则 EP0 要求一条遍历 A 全部 32 点的 u–v 路径含端点边 uv； 这在简单路径中不可能，所以这个交叉组合由 EP0 自身排除， 无需增加新假设。EP0 中 qs 不属于补配边，因为 q 是补后孔， 也不属于 M_A，因为 q 原为交叉端口；故删除它不会丢失原匹配。

反例及有限证据复核

本审查阅读了原 probe、solver-free verifier 和相应 JSON，随后另写一次性 Python 重构全部短边、端口、S、单切分禁边和共同禁边；没有调用匹配求解器或复用原 verifier 作为判定黑盒，也没有重写其现有结果文件。21 个见证都逐边核验： 28 边、56 个不同端点、八个孔精确、短边、孔独立、目标被覆盖、正确 (2,0) 行、 所有奇端口对 S 均无短邻接。

七个共同删边图的 Hall 证书重核结果如下，邻集全为空：

删边图中这些原本应覆盖的偶顶点无法匹配，因此每个实现匹配都使用至少一条删除边， 其对应切分就有 eligible 邻接。这一论证是全称的匹配排除， 但只针对七代表及其对称像；不是所有 (2,0) 几何上的 EP0 定理。 Q4 的诊断负例 JSON 已阅读；没有重跑 Q4 的负搜索，也没有据此断言 Q5 T15 为假。

反例尝试覆盖：v 为交叉端口；q=v；s=u；二镜像同一 T 边；tag 所在片段遇镜像； 所有交叉端口为奇；最小允许 c；qs 与 D/原匹配重合；所有可选切分均无 exposure。 前七项由上述账本排除错误或直接处理；固定切分无 exposure 确有 21 个见证； 七例中同时所有切分无 exposure 则被 Hall 证书排除。

精确保留的开放义务
  • T15：OPEN。 对任意 K(Q5) 匹配、一偶五奇孔、任意指定两奇孔的 30 点避点圈。 本文没有证明它；A6/K6 和 Q4 诊断均不能替代这个量词。
  • 合适切分上的 EP0：OPEN。 对需要 (2,0) 的每个原匹配，须选出一个切分及 r,q,D,P,s，使 P 确实包含 qs。eligible 邻接只是必要条件，不是充分证书。
  • 任意固定 (2,0) 切分均满足 EP0：FALSE。 21 个明确短匹配已否定该更强说法。
  • R8-covered：OPEN；完整八孔所有端点：OPEN；完整 P6：OPEN。

不存在需要修补的 FATAL/CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR 条件证明错误；上述 OPEN 是草稿 明确声明的假设与后续研究义务，未被计作已证明。审查结论仅允许登记条件归约已通过， 不授权无条件数学关闭或更改主研究状态。

Q5 K4 的精确量词为任意完整图匹配、平衡四孔、任意自由根和异奇偶目标， 目标可以已覆盖。重读 SIX_HOLE_MIXED_AND_GEOMETRY.md 中的 K4 证明： 自由目标用辅助边及 N10；已覆盖目标删其原边、接根后用 A4，再展开恢复。 人工长边和同奇偶边都在该量词内。该旧文件中的 A4 未证说明属于历史状态； CANONICAL_COMPLETION_REVIEW.json 的完整 A4 PASS 已明确解除它，且未反向使用 本八孔结论。N10 由 GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT_REVIEW.json 导入。

EIGHT_HOLE_CONDITIONAL_REDUCTION_REVIEW.md — Eight-hole conditional reduction: independent review

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：f420c2570d3efd1b580379a6e0b1dfce982c6b85d56b8038ba45dabffcf43a59。

Eight-hole conditional reduction: independent review

Date: 2026-11-01. PASS for the stated conditional reduction, relative to explicit imports. Reviewer route: ARIS proof-checker, user-selected GPT-6.1-sol / high. review_independence: same-family; acceptance_status: provisional. The reviewed draft, producer census and producer result are hashed in the accompanying JSON. The draft and main research state were not changed by this review.

The checked conclusion is A6 implies the complete Q6 eight-hole free-target theorem, and the stated nine-cut criterion handles the indicated covered targets. Conditional on A6, full eight-hole P6 is equivalent to the additional R8-covered assertion. A6 and R8-covered remain unproved here; full P6 remains unproved. No local FATAL, CRITICAL or MAJOR gap was found.

Imported assumptions and dependency boundary

This review imports the perfect-matching extension theorem for arbitrary matchings of K(Q5); N10 from GENERAL_NEAR_PERFECT.md; N14 from the initial lemma of TWO_ODD_HOLES_TRANSFER.md; full A4 from CANONICAL_A4_CLOSURE.md; K4 from SIX_HOLE_MIXED_AND_GEOMETRY.md, with its A4 assumption discharged by that closure; and full six-hole Q6 P6 from SIX_HOLE_CLOSED.md. These inputs are not recursively reproved or recertified in this audit. The full six-hole and A4 packages retain their same-family/provisional assurance and finite-certificate dependencies.

The five-direction theorem is also imported: local paper.txt, Theorem 8, lines 189ff. For c=0, the original short matching avoids a coordinate. Its free root excludes C1, C2 and C3 (each requires covering the root), so its hypotheses hold. This audit does not recertify that theorem's computer-assisted five-dimensional input.

A6 is an explicit additional universal hypothesis about arbitrary K(Q5) matchings, not merely short or bipartite matchings, with hole parity counts 4 and 2 and any prescribed majority hole omitted. All imported parity statements allow exchanging the parity classes. Consequently global parity labels can be used on either face.

Dependency DAG: perfect/N10/K4 and N14/A4/A6 -> local endpoint lemma -> nine transfer rows; full six-hole P6 -> preliminary augmentations; five-direction theorem -> c=0; these reductions plus the geometry certificate and root-bridge argument -> all free targets; nine-row complement -> R8-covered characterization. No use of eight-hole P6, R8-covered, or a consequence of either occurs upstream. Historical open-A4 wording in older imports does not supersede the explicitly selected closure dependency.

Proof-obligation ledger
ID Application and hypothesis discharge Result
L1 Section 1, free y: adding ry is a matching, consumes two holes with parity sum h, and leaves 0,2,4 balanced holes. Perfect/N10/K4 supply a full circle; remove ry. Closed modulo imports
L2 Section 1, covered y: k=F(y), replace yk by kr. The holes replace r by y, hence imbalance h-epsilon(r)+epsilon(y)=2epsilon(y), with 2t unchanged and y free. N14/A4/A6 omits precisely y. Opening kr and restoring original ky gives the requested full path. Closed modulo imports/A6
L3 Balanced 2/4/6-hole circle corollary: choose a short neighbor of a free root as target. A 32-vertex Hamilton path cannot already contain its endpoint edge; closing adds a permitted short edge. Closed
P1 A nonroot adjacent hole pair can be adjoined without covering u. Exactly six holes remain, so full six-hole P6 applies to the original prescribed endpoints. Closed modulo import
P2 Free v adjacent to u: adjoin uv, close a six-hole Hamilton path from another free root to its short neighbor, then delete uv. The enlarged matching really contains uv. Closed modulo import
F1 D uses only crossports and, when needed, the chosen original hole x; it is disjoint from M_A. For delta=0 the root port p is even, so p differs from odd v. Closed
F2 Removing D from the A path gives a path forest. Each crossport receives a different B endpoint. A covered v in X_A can be isolated when its D edge is deleted; its real crossedge restores its terminal segment. Closed
F3 For delta=1, D is nonempty and its removal separates u and v even if a D edge touches v. Thus rs joins distinct terminals. For delta=0, ur joins the free B root to a crossport, so its endpoints differ. Closed
F4 Bridge mirror y is internally covered: it is neither a hole (by independence and the explicit root exclusion) nor a crossport (its unique opposite-face neighbor is the free x). A nonterminal y yields exactly one M_B/R conflict. Closed
F5 In the conflict repair k is internally covered, d a crossport, and k,d,y are distinct. Thus kd forms a matching after removing yk and yd. Expansion restores both originals and the omitted y exactly once. Closed
T0 b=a+1, a=0,1,2: port imbalance b-a-delta is 0 or 1; D completion leaves A holes (a+1,a+1); after terminal closure B holes are (3-a,3-a). Every local hole total is 2,4,6. Closed
TE b=a, a=1,2,3: choose an even nonroot hole x; its odd mirror y is internal. A holes (a,a). Nonterminal repair plus rs/ur leaves (3-a,5-a), with majority hole y; use A6/A4/N14 at a=1/2/3. Closed modulo A6
TO b=a+2, a=0,1,2: choose an odd hole x distinct from free v and with mirror y not u; A holes (a+1,a+1). Nonterminal B holes are (4-a,2-a), with majority y; use A6/A4/N14 at a=0/1/2. Closed modulo A6

孔投影的语义与独立重建

固定一条 a2b1 切分 i，A 含目标 v。A 中恰有偶孔 z1,z2 和奇孔 w； 设 q 为 B 中唯一的非根偶孔，即 Z 中不在 A 的那个元素。 记 Y={z1 xor e_i,z2 xor e_i}。

由已审通过的双桥转移，若根 u 在 A，最终局部孔是 H_B∪Y； 若根在 B，tagged closure 消耗 u，最终孔是 (H_B\{u})∪Y。 两个分支的局部孔因而都精确等于

{q} ∪ (W∩B) ∪ Y，其中 q 偶、其余五孔奇，指定避点恰为 Y。

Y 不与 W 重合由 Z–W 独立性保证，且 q、五个奇孔都在同一 B 面。 把 B 中全部顶点先平移 q，再删除第 i 坐标，即得到标准 Q5，q 变为 0。 由于所有点原第 i 位相同，平移后该位为 0；q 全局为偶， 因此投影后的五孔确为奇点。独立验证器采用“按坐标列表重组位”的投影实现， 没有调用作者的移位掩码公式。

三个 included 奇孔来自 W∩B；它们不与 q 短邻接，所以规范重量都大于 1。 Y 中的 avoided 奇孔允许与 q 相邻，不能把这一自由度也错误排除。 这精确解释了 analytic geometry 域中“included 从非邻奇点选，avoided 从其余奇点选”的约束。 所有 165403 个切分均逐项通过上述条件。

本轮映射是孔几何的规范化匹配，不是对某一条原匹配 M 的采样， 也没有试图从孔几何还原压缩后的完整图匹配。每个待证核心必须对其固定孔几何的 任意完整图匹配成立，才能用于已审的条件归约。

T15 条件测试与轨道分类

在投影 Q5 上，每个坐标分别检查：

  • 若指定两避点分处两面，含第一避点那面的“奇孔数−偶孔数”等于 2， 即对应已证的两孔/1:3 分离避点切分。
  • 若两避点同面，且该面不含少数孔 0、恰含四个奇孔，则为同面 good cut。
  • 当分离避点条件不成立时，对全部同面 good cut 的坐标分区，检查是否有 奇数个已覆盖顶点的 cell；这是强制某个 good cut 有正交叉数的 cell-parity 条件。

所有实际投影都没有任何 direct good cut，故 split 和 cell-parity 测试都失败。 因此此次 0 的计算不依赖尚需审查的同面正交叉转移是否已完整成立， 也不需要假设某个原匹配的交叉数为正。

独立枚举规范少数孔为 0 的完整相关孔域： 从 11 个重量大于 1 的奇点选 3 个 included，再从另外 13 个奇点选 2 个 avoided， 共 C(11,3) C(13,2)=12870 个带类型孔配置。 对每个没有 direct good cut 的配置，在全部 120 个坐标置换下求 (sorted avoided, sorted included) 的最小值。 所得 54 个残余轨道及各自 count 与输入 JSON 逐项一致。

随后以每个真实投影的独立 canonical 最小值匹配该 54 核表， 不使用作者预先构造的反向 lookup。全部投影均找到对应核心； 实际出现 41 个不同核心轨道。每条父几何的所有可选 core、每条切分见证、 各核的不同父几何频数及完整 used_cores 内容均与 JSON 一致。

精确结论：对每个 M⊆E(Q6)，若其自由集恰有四点，则对每个自由点 u 和每个满足 p(v)≠p(u) 的顶点 v，存在遍历全部顶点并包含全部 M 的 u—v 路径。

Assumptions / Notation

V(Qn)={0,1}n；p 为坐标和模二；ei 为第 i 坐标单位向量；短边的汉明距离为一。K(Qn) 允许任意不同端点，B(Qn) 只允许异奇偶端点。所谓延拓只允许新增短边，但输入中已有的长边必须保留。坐标面限制的奇偶与局部标准奇偶至多整体翻转，因而同/异奇偶关系不变。

对短匹配平移 x↦x⊕u 后可令 u=0；该双射保持短边、不同顶点、Hamilton 性、方向数、同/异奇偶关系。孔于是为不同的偶点 u,z 和奇点 w,t。被覆盖的奇目标 v 有偶伙伴 h=M(v)，且 h≠u。因此

M*=(M⧵{vh})∪{hu}

为匹配，孔恰为 v,z,w,t；hu 是同偶长边，确实不可能是短边。原文的“唯一可能的长边”是安全的宽松措辞。跨边在这里意为两端分处坐标面，不要求为该方向的短边。

External inputs and hypothesis discharge

独立读取 Fink–Mütze 作者全文 第 1、3、4 页；只将其 Theorems 2、8、9、12 和 extension 的定义作为外部输入。其条件分别为完整图完美匹配、避指定点且满足半层条件 (H)、二部完美匹配端点压缩无半层、以及完整图删异奇偶两点后的完美匹配无半层。下列应用全部保持各自的完整图/二部图区别；所有避孔定理的维数均至少五。

独立读取本地 paper.txt 中 Fink–Hotmar Theorem 8 及 C1/C2/C3（并核对本地 PDF 存在）。该输入要求 n≥5、短匹配、使用至多五方向、端点异奇偶。Z14 零跨边和 Z17 第 4 节确实证明的是原短匹配完全不使用一个方向，根 u 在原匹配中自由。C1 要求根被半层覆盖，C2 要求根 incident 的指定匹配边，C3 要求 uv∈M；自由根逐个排除三者。因此可用该定理，未把 M* 或任意长边匹配送入五方向输入。此输入和作者避点定理含其论文自己的计算辅助基例；本报告将定理作为引用输入，没有复现其整篇证明或基例程序。

Proof supplements / complete derivations

这些是 ADD_DERIVATION 型补写建议，不是对命题增加前提，也没有写回主证明。

1. 同奇偶两孔为何强制几乎覆盖全部

令 EV,OV 为所考察结构覆盖的偶、奇顶点数，EE,OE 为其中同偶、同奇边数。对匹配 T，有 EV−OV=2(EE−OE)；对圈 C，按顶点度二计数，有 EV−OV=EE−OE。若两孔同奇偶，取其符号 ϵ∈{1,−1}，匹配端点差为 −2ϵ，匹配同奇偶边差为 −ϵ。延拓只加异奇偶短边，后者不变。圈若两孔均不含，就同时要求顶点差 −2ϵ=−ϵ，矛盾。避开一个孔的圈只能再加入另一个孔，因此恰覆盖其余全部顶点。这对 N10/N14 的任意同奇偶长边均有效，不假设新增边外的输入二部。

2. 切圈、切路径与真实跨边

一个圈删去非空匹配 D：每点至多失去一条 incident 边，因此没有孤点；剩余图是该原圈的真子图，不可能有圈分量，只能是非平凡路径。一个路径删匹配 D，若 D 不接触原两端，同样每个内点至少剩一条边，两端保留，故无孤点。Z9/Z16 的 D 均满足此条件，包括 Z16 的 a=z 分支，因为 a 所在 ak 已从 W 删除。

向每个 A 端口接回自己原来的跨边，使用的是 C* 两端间的真实配对；不以位翻转邻点替代长跨边 hu。附加桥各自连接不同的原孔或已核验冲突点。路径内部均在 A，B 端点互异，所以缩成 R 无环、无重端点。将 B 圈中的 R 边逐一细分回对应路径，保持单圈；若有唯一冲突，将其顶点先从 B 圈删掉、再在特定 rs 展开中加回一次。所有 M* 边保留，特别是长 hu；最后才删 hu、在 h 端加回短 hv。这一恢复步骤不要求 hu 在某面内。

3. 双候选压缩共同半层的完整理由

在 Q5 面中每个半层八条短边。设两候选不同、同偶，且各自短伙伴边互异。两个压缩各删除一条原边、增加一条辅助边。若第一压缩含半层 Hb，至少七条 Hb 边为原边；第二压缩最多再删其中一条，因此仍保留至少六条这些方向 j 的短边。若第二压缩也含半层，H1 强制其方向为 j。两压缩都避开自由点 v，方向 j 只有一个避 v 的半层，故二者实际为同一 H。

第一压缩漏 b，第二漏 e，故 b,e 都在 H 的端点补集。原 bkb 仍在第二压缩（两候选边不同），所以匹配性使 kb 也在该补集，否则与 H 的边撞点。因此第一新增辅助边（ukb 或 akb）不可能在 H；其余 H 边都是原边。结论为真实 H⊆MA，避开两候选。适用于 Z17 第 3、5 节；后者只把辅助端口 u 换为 a，并未要求它也是原根。

在 Z17 第 2 节的特殊分支，两候选恰为 u,h，原同偶边 hu 被删，记余匹配 F。两压缩为 F+ah、F+au。一个半层至少七条边在 F，且全部保留于另一压缩，故两半层同方向；共同避 v 又使其相同。两辅助边不同且不属于 F（a,u,h 在 F 中自由），交集恰为 F；共同半层因此完全属于 F，自动避开 u,h。该分支不能以普通“短候选边不同”的理由代替；原文正确单独处理了它。

4. 真半层换切分并非只换孔的位标签

旧目标面 Ai 的半层沿 j≠i，且避 v。它在新面 Aj 内的端点恰为

U={x:xi=vi, xj=vj, p(x)≠p(v)}.

这些顶点已与新面外的顶点沿 j 匹配。假定新面含沿 k≠j 的半层且避 v：对与 v 异奇偶的点，其端点条件为 xk=vk。若 k=i，整个 U 满足；若 i,j,k 不同，n≥4 保证尚有一自由坐标可调奇偶，因此也有 U 中点满足。该点同时需要两条不同方向匹配边，矛盾。由此 E2 对同一个实际全局匹配成立，包含长边也不影响。

Z17 障碍半层的补集含奇 v 和偶 b,e，由去掉 j 的坐标和相同，得到 bj=ej≠vj。又 j≠i，故 wj=bj,tj=ej。八条原半层边的两端确实在新切分异面，成为至少八条真实跨边。新目标面若单孔，端口数等于 32−1 模二，故至少九；若双孔，则为偶数至少八。这逐个满足 Z9.4 或 Z16，而不是假设所有新坐标切分都可用。

5. Z18 第二坐标的穷尽性

第一次选 vi≠zi 总存在，因为二者奇偶相反。若 Z14/Z15 均不适用，必须 wi=ti=zi≠vi。调用 Z17 若没有直接产生路径，其边界要求 u,v 同面且有候选等于 u。平移后 u=0，交换奇孔令 w=ei，于是

vi=0,zi=wi=ti=1,h=v⊕ei.

这里最后等式使用原唯一跨边 vh 是短边。孔 z 与被覆盖点 h 不同，所以 z≠v⊕ei。同时 zi≠vi，必存在 j≠i 使 zj≠vj。在该 j 再按二进制分类：若 wj≠tj 用 Z14；若 wj=tj=vj 用 Z15；其余只能 wj=tj=zj≠vj。由于 w=ei 且 j≠i，有

uj=wj=tj=zj=0,vj=1.

所以第二次 Z17 的目标侧仍单孔，但 u,v 必异面，绝不满足它留下的“根与目标同面”边界。Z17 第一结论必成立。不需要无限次重选坐标，不需要预先固定 j，也不需要关于 d(z,v) 的额外假设。

候选仅一个且恰为唯一端口 u Z17 第 3 节明确允许边界，Z18 第二坐标消除。没有把端口误称内部覆盖。
hu 为真实长跨边、或冲突边恰 hu 转移保留其端点配对；冲突展开恢复该边后再最终删除。没有使用其短性。
Z16 的 a=z D 不接触 a，端点公式仍成立，桥 zy 从该端点接出，不出现孤点或重复 z。
Z16 的 y 成为第二冲突／原自由点 奇偶排除 u,h，非邻接排除 w,t，自由邻点 z 排除原跨匹配；恰一个覆盖冲突。
某压缩新增辅助边补齐了假半层，无法转回原匹配 双压缩保留至少六条原短边、共同避 v，迫使同半层；补集伙伴论证排除新增边。
删 D 产生孤立路径端点／整圈未断 圈分支 D 非空，匹配最多删 incident 一边；路径分支避原端点。上述度数论证排除。
第二坐标不存在，即 z=h 原孔与原匹配端点不相交，直接矛盾，故不存在该失败输入。
维数降到四、自由集降到二 这些是真实危险但不在调用范围：本链只在 Q5 面调用避孔定理和 N12，|Y|≥4；单跨边不用 N12。
N6 相邻孔或丢失 rs 长边 N6 明确非相邻；N7 将相邻单独处理。选 x 排除 r,s,y,P(y)，确保 rs 在压缩中保留。

以上为结构反例尝试，没有声称它们构成所有匹配的穷举。所有关键全称结论依靠前述推导。实际运行现有证书验证器：verify_recut.py 9 个、verify_two_odd_holes.py 81 个、verify_conflict_cycles.py 12 个全部通过；后者包括 1 个冲突边等于 hu 的证书。这仅核验相应具体路径/圈，没有以 102 个实例代替 Z18 全称证明。

Corrections / Open Risks

没有需要改变原命题的修补，没有新假设。建议在成稿把双候选半层交集、Z16 的 a=z 端点核算、以及五方向三项禁止条件逐项排除写入正文；完整推导已在本报告给出。

结论是相对于明确外部定理的常规数学语义审读 PASS，仍为同模型族临时接受；没有跨模型族覆盖，没有 Lean/其他形式化证明。外部定理整体证明不在本次重证范围内。作者 PDF 通过 web 成功读取；沙箱网络禁止直接下载原始 PDF 字节，所以不伪造其原始文件 SHA256。机器报告记录本地每个实际声明输入的 SHA256，外部 URL 及未获得原文件哈希的原因单列。六孔及更多孔仍开放，不能把本结论或样例检查称为完整 P6。

2. 规范量词与依赖图

N10。 对每个整数 n≥5、每个 K(Q_n) 匹配 L，若未覆盖点恰为不同的 r,s，则对每个 y≠r 且 p(y)=p(s) 的顶点，存在包含全部 L 的 Hamilton r—y 路径，其余边全部短。L 无二部性要求；r,s 无异奇偶要求。

Z6。 对每个 n≥6、每个满足列明四孔/奇偶/切分/目标条件的短匹配 M，若存在所述二部配对 D 及包含 P_A=M_A∪D 的 Hamilton c—d 延拓，则存在包含 M 的 Hamilton u—v 路径。这个 K_A 的存在是显式前提。修订允许 d=u。

E1。 对每个 m≥5、每个完整二部图完美匹配 P，若不同的 c,d,e 满足列明奇偶、三条端点匹配边为短边、cd,ce∉P，且两个压缩都含半层，则 cP(c) 的方向属于 J={j:d_j=e_j≠c_j}。反命题的逆否形式及 Theorem 9 给出至少一个可延拓端点对。

Z7。 对每个恰有孔 {0,3,13,49} 的 Q_6 短匹配 M，对每个 Hamming 重量为奇数且最低位为 1 的顶点 v，存在包含 M 的 Hamilton 0—v 路径。这里的量词是全部此孔配置的匹配，不是某个保存实例；没有量化其他孔配置或最低位 0 的已覆盖目标。

依赖 DAG：

半层坐标结构 + Theorem 8 + Theorem 2 + 奇偶度数恒等式 → N10
二部完美匹配沿路径交替 + N10 + 不交路径展开 → Z6
半层坐标结构 → Z0

5. C — 代数、计数与逐步义务
N10

N10-01：分支穷尽。 y=s 与 y≠s 构成全部情形。前者删去唯一辅助 rs 得到指定路径，原匹配边不受影响。

N10-02：换配合法。 在后一分支，y 既不是 r 也不是 s，故有唯一伙伴 p。匹配无环且 r,s 未覆盖，因此 p,r,y,s 两两不同。删除 yp 后 p,y 空出；添加 pr 恰占用 p,r，故 T 的孔恰为 y,s。

N10-03：(H) 自动成立。 令 f_j(x)=∑_{k≠j}x_k mod 2。一个 j 半层的端点集是 f_j 的一个水平集，补集是另一个。若该半层属于 T，则 y,s 位于补集，所以 f_j(y)=f_j(s)。又 p(y)=p(s)，由 p(x)=f_j(x)+x_j mod 2 得 y_j=s_j。因此 s 是禁点 y 所在 j 坐标层内另一个未覆盖点。对每个含半层的 j 单独成立；若无半层，该方向的条件为空真。

N10-04：圈必须覆盖 s。 定义 Δ(E)=#同偶边−#同奇边。匹配 T 覆盖顶点的偶奇差是 −2χ(y)，所以 Δ(T)=−χ(y)。新增短边对 Δ 的贡献为 0。任一圈 C 的有符号度数求和给出 |V_even(C)|−|V_odd(C)|=Δ(C)。C 已包含所有 T 端点且漏 y；若也漏 s，左边为 −2χ(y)，右边为 −χ(y)，矛盾。因此 C 恰覆盖除 y 外全部顶点。

N10-05：手术保留边并精确覆盖。 从简单圈 C 删 pr 得简单 p—r 路径，顶点恰为全体除 y；在 p 端接上 yp 得 y—r Hamilton 路径。这等价于原稿“先插入 y，再删 yr”。直接写最终边集为 E(F)=(E(C)\{pr})∪{yp}，故全部 L 恢复；其他边属于 E(C)\T⊆E(Q_n)。无需假设 pr 或临时 yr 为短边。

N10-06：奇偶条件必要。 L 的两个孔是 r,s，故 2Δ(L)=−χ(r)−χ(s)。若 F 为覆盖全部顶点的 r—y 路径，路径的有符号度数和给出 2Δ(F)=−χ(r)−χ(y)。全部新增边短意味着 Δ(F)=Δ(L)，所以 χ(y)=χ(s)。这同时覆盖同奇偶双孔与异奇偶双孔。

Z6

Z6-01：配对与端点。 A 内完美二部匹配有唯一交替边位置：从奇 c 到偶 d 沿路径，规定匹配边均为奇→偶。集合 X_A∪{u} 恰为 M_A 的未覆盖点，故奇偶平衡，可在完整二部图内配对。该集合包含 u，所以 D 不为空。c 既非 u，也非跨端口。d 若不等于 u 则同样由 M_A 覆盖。

Z6-02：删 D 的全部情形。 若 d≠u，D 不接触路径两端，且不同 D 边不相邻，故分段均非平凡。若 d=u，只有末边接触路径端点，删除它产生唯一单点 {u}；其他分段非平凡。不存在未计入的内部孤立点。

Z6-03：转移。 跨边端口互异，且 z,t 均为原孔而不属于 X_B；因此给各 A 端点接上 C、cz、dt 不会合并不同路径，也不会重复 B 顶点。d=u 时单点被 ut 恰扩为 J。转移后端点集确为 X_B∪{u,z,t}。

Z6-04：q 分类。 d=u 时 q=t。否则 u 是某条被删除的奇→偶 D 边的后端；若其段后面还有被删除 D 边，该段末端是奇点，跨过去 q 为偶端口；若没有，末端为 d，故 q=t。u 段不含起点 c，因此 q≠z。全部情形中 q∈X_B 且偶，或 q=t；所以 q 既不等于奇且被覆盖的 v，也不等于自由孔 w。

Z6-05：压缩。 J 以外的路径两端均为不同 B 顶点，且彼此端点不交，构成 R；其端点集是 (X_B∪{z,t})\{q}。M_B 的端点与 R 的端点不交，因此 L_B 是真正匹配而非多重边结构，恰漏 q,w。若 v 是跨端口，v 可以由 R 覆盖，这不妨碍 N10。

Z6-06：展开。 对 K_B 的每条 R 边，以其对应 A 路径替换；所有 B 顶点仍恰出现一次，各 A 内部点集合不交。最后接入 J 只在 q 与已有路径接触，把端点 q 改为 u，并恢复 J 的 A 顶点。即使 R 边接触目标 v，也仍保持 v 为最终端点。MA、MB、C 三类原边全部保留；D 删除、R 展开；其余边只来自两个局部短边延拓与 cz、dt。

E1 与 Z7

E1-01：方向相同。 第一压缩的半层至少贡献 2^(m−2)−1≥7 条 P 的 j 短边；第二压缩至多排除其中 2 条，至少剩 5 条。Z0 令所有剩余短边沿 k，故 j=k。方向固定后，两个半层端点集互补，而 c 在两压缩中均未覆盖，故它们只能是同一半层。

E1-02：排除“新增边补半层”。 c,d,e 全在半层补集 T。第二压缩的 Z0 迫使未触及 c,e 的短边 dP(d) 沿 j，故 P(d) 仍在 T。于是第一压缩新增伙伴边 P(c)P(d) 不属于半层。整个半层原已包含于 P，其全部端点均已匹配，因此 P(c)∈T。短边 cP(c) 在 T 内，必沿 j。c 与 d,e 异奇偶而同在 T，故其 j 位均相反，j∈J。

Z7-01：明确坐标。 c=2 的支撑为 {1}，d=12、e=48 的支撑为 {2,3}、{4,5}。所以 J={1}，两个候选端点均与 c 距离 3。它们不是孔，且跨层伙伴是孔，因而匹配边均是原 MA 短边且不属于 D。根 0 未覆盖，故 P_A(c)≠0，c 的匹配方向不能为 1。E1 的逆否结论排除两个端点同时失败。

Z7-02：目标分支完备。 bit0=1 的奇目标要么为自由孔 13/49，要么原已覆盖。前者使用 N8；后者使用刚证明的 K_A 及 Z6。v=61 的 Hamming 重量为 5 且 bit0=1，确实在已覆盖分支的全称范围内。

  • E，概率模式： 全称命题与存在性证明均为确定性的，没有从随机样例升级为必然结论。随机生成的路径证书仅作为有限回归。
  • F，常数和一致性： 无 O/o/Θ 或隐藏渐近常数。维数门槛 N10≥5、Z6≥6、E1≥5、Z7=6 均在应用处核对。E1 使用明确整数界 2^(m−2)−1≥7，没有参数依赖遗漏。

11. Z8 增补审读：同奇偶双孔距离 2

新增输入 DISTANCE_TWO_UNBALANCED.md，独立 fresh gpt-6-astra / ultra 审员 /root/general_near_perfect_audit/fresh_z8。主审与 fresh 审员均未发现实质缺口；本节结论为 PASS，same-family/provisional。

规范量词。 对每个 Q6 短匹配 M，若孔恰为 u,z,w,t，同奇偶的 u,z 距离 2；对每个与 u 异奇偶的 v，若存在一个坐标切分把 u 单独置于 A，并把 z,w,t,v 全部置于 B，则存在包含 M 的 Hamilton u—v 路径。对每个 M 可选择依赖于 M 的配对 D；没有声称一个 D 对所有 M 通用。

A — 定义与对称归一化

平移 x↦x⊕u 是图自同构，保持匹配、短边方向、Hamming 距离和相对奇偶，并把切分中含 u 的一侧变为第 i 位 0。因此可以令 u=0，z 的重量为 2，z_i=1，而 c=z⊕e_i 的重量为 1。全局奇偶若翻转，也同时翻转全部顶点，原先的同/异奇偶条件不变。局部坐标中没有把分层位 i 误计为 A 内方向。

B — 应用假设完整账本
应用 条件逐项核对
L15：N8 M 是二部四孔匹配，维数 6≥5；目标自由且与根异奇偶，因此目标只能是 w 或 t
L15：N10 若 z 与 w 或 t 相邻，添加这条自由点间短边得到恰两孔匹配；根 u 仍自由，另一孔与目标 v 同奇偶；v≠u；删孔没有删除 M 的任何边
L23：Fink 完美匹配圈定理 只有一条跨边时，MA 恰漏 u,a；添加 ua 是完整图的合法完美匹配，层维数为 5；删除唯一辅助 ua 后全部新增边仍短
L23：原五方向 Theorem 8 MB 是 Q5 的短匹配，至多五方向；b 未被 MB 覆盖；b 与 v 异奇偶，且 b≠v；以下逐项排除 C1–C3
L31：E1 及其证明中已建立的共同半层结论 PA 是完整二部图完美匹配；c,d,e 不同，c 奇、d,e 偶；三条端点匹配边均来自 MA 且短；cd,ce 均不是 PA 边；层维数 5
L35：GNS 端点定理 上述维数/二部/异奇偶/非匹配边条件已满足；选配对矛盾给出至少一个无半层压缩
L35：Z6 同一切分；第一层路径由前项得到；按所选 d 或 e，把其对应的奇孔命名为 Z6 中的 t、另一奇孔为 w；目标已覆盖、奇且在 B

原五方向输入直接核对了 Fink–Hotmar, arXiv:2501.19029v1 第 3 页条件 C1–C3 与第 4 页 Theorem 8。C1 要求根被半层覆盖，C2 要求存在根的匹配边，C3 要求两端点的边在匹配中。因为 b 在 MB 中自由，三者均不成立。这里应用的是论文的 Theorem 8，不把一般维数的猜想作为前提，也不把此定理用于含人工长边的 PA 或 LB。

C — 各分支与关键代数
  1. 自由目标分支与已覆盖目标分支穷尽。后者若 z 与任一奇孔相邻，辅助短边分支立即结束；剩下 dist(z,w),dist(z,t)≥3，因为这些距离为奇数。
  2. c,d,e 的 B 邻点均是原孔，所以它们不能是跨边端口。c 是奇点，不是根；若 d=u，则 w=e_i，因 z 重量为 2 且含 i，得到 dist(z,w)=1，与剩余分支矛盾；e 同理。因此三点都由 MA 覆盖。它们的两相关距离等于 dist(z,w)、dist(z,t)，所以 cd,ce 不是 MA 边；D 也不接触它们。
  3. 设 XA 中偶/奇顶点数为 E/O。MA 在 A 的两类覆盖数相等，其未覆盖集为 XA∪{u}，故 O=E+1。于是跨边数 O+E=2E+1 为正奇数。只有 1 条与至少 3 条两分支互斥且穷尽，0 或偶数条不会遗漏。
  4. 单跨边时 E=0、O=1，所以 a 奇、b 偶；MA 恰漏 u,a。两个层内 Hamilton 路径顶点集不交，端点 a,b 由唯一原跨边 ab 相接；正好得到一条覆盖全 Q6 的 u—v 路径，MA、MB、ab 全部保留。
  5. 多跨边时 O≥2。令 j 是 c 的原 MA 边方向；j 是 A 内方向。若 j 是 c 的唯一 1 位，则其伙伴是 u，违背 u 自由；故 c_j=u_j=0。奇端口至少两个，排除至多一个 u⊕e_j 后仍可选择 a。删除自由偶点 u 与自由奇点 a 后，余下端口仍奇偶平衡，所以 D 存在且 P_A(u)=a≠u⊕e_j。
  6. 假设两个压缩都含半层，E1 的证明给出相同半层 H，完整地包含于 PA；其方向恰为 c 的 PA 边方向，即 j。这里使用的是 E1 证明已经明确推出的中间结论，并非仅凭 E1 最后一句自行加强。
  7. 半层补集 T 含 c。因 c_j=0 且 c 重量为 1，去掉 j 的坐标和为奇，T 是奇水平集；u 的该和为偶，所以 u 属于 H 的端点集 S。完整 H 包含于 PA，迫使 PA 在 u 使用 j 短边，即 P_A(u)=u⊕e_j，与选 D 矛盾。因此至少一次压缩没有半层；GNS 后接 Z6 正好给出目标结论。
D、E、F — 交换、概率、维数

没有极限/积分/导数交换，没有概率结论或渐近符号。全称证明不依赖样例。单跨边分支严格在 Q5 应用五方向定理；多跨边使用完整二部 PA 与完整图 LB 的相应定理，未把长边计作短边方向。

G — 边界与反例尝试

检查了原根为奇顶点、自由目标、两种相邻孔提前分支、d=u 或 e=u、跨边数 0/偶数/1/3、恰两个奇端口且其中一个被排除、a 与 u 不相邻、目标为跨端口、两候选端点任选其一、j 与切分方向或 c 的唯一 1 位重合的可能性。前述分支或明确矛盾均处理这些情况，无需增加条件。

“任取 D”在本推广中不可当作论据：这里必须使用 D(u)≠u⊕e_j 的有意选择。作者给出的有限例 {0,3,13,21} 正好说明这个区别；这不影响 Z7 的特定几何下任取 D 的更强局部事实。

作者另给出 distance_two_results.json 的 56 条有限路径，覆盖 55 种所选归一化孔几何及 1 个双半层修复例；其中 5 条单跨边、51 条多跨边。distance_two_verification.json 记录同一独立标准库验证器返回 PASS，多跨边中 q=t 有 21 条、q 偶有 30 条，51 条 LB 均含同奇偶辅助边。这是有限构造覆盖范围，不是所有匹配或所有孔/目标组合的枚举证明。本审读不以这些路径承担任何上面的推导。

H — 依赖、范围及最终判定

依赖为 N8 / N10 / Fink圈定理 / 五方向Theorem8 / E1 / GNS / Z6 → Z8；所有箭头都指向此前已证明或明确引用的结果，Z8 没有被上游使用。命题覆盖 Z7 的距离 2 配置及满足同样一孔/三孔位置约束的更多配置，但仍要求目标与另外三个孔在同一侧。没有覆盖目标在 A 或根不能单独分层的情形，没有证明完整 P6。

主审与 fresh ultra 审员均未发现实质缺口，未修改数学内容。fresh 审员特别复核 E1 的证明确有共同 H⊆P 的中间结论、单跨边 Theorem 8 没有要求目标也自由、Z6 允许目标为原跨端口。Z8 在当前固定版本与明确外部输入下通过本次审读；仍仅为 same-family/provisional。

HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_REVIEW.md — Independent review: higher forced-cherry conditional transfer

原件：打开文件。SHA-256：aac61d56cbb1cf8c39fa5e6d4911f1616332a737787588688a30b180f693c9f7。

Independent review: higher forced-cherry conditional transfer

Date: 2026-11-01. Reviewer: /root/higher_forced_cherry_review, user-specified GPT-6.1-sol/high. ARIS proof-checker review; the explicit user model route overrides the skill's default model route. This is the fresh reviewer, not the producer. No producer or production-state file was edited.

Verdict: PASS modulo the explicitly declared imports and local inputs. Review independence is same-family and acceptance is provisional. No FATAL, CRITICAL, MAJOR, or MINOR mathematical issue remains open. The rank in Section 5 is the GF(2) rank associated with the referenced matching-connectivity bound, as detailed below; this is the imported convention, not an assertion over arbitrary fields.

Frozen input and scope

Reviewed HIGHER_FORCED_CHERRY_TRANSFER.md, SHA256 a5030f66772259eeb32402c25f92a77761acb454e70696b2d370c652037fbea4, against manifest SHA256 cb6bcfdd38dcd155c202dd84914908bcaf8b638d7484a0ac4cc75a8cd84b6e56. Independently rehashed all 13 manifest inputs; all agree. Read the current A10 assembly, all-balanced endpoint reduction and final acceptance record, older single-cherry transfer and accepted batch record, uniform transfer and its accepted import record, and the rank-primary-source note. Those earlier results are imports; this review does not rerun their large certificates or independently reprove them.

The accepted conclusions here are: (T1) one-cherry conditional Q6 transfer, (T2) the general reduced-rank local classification, and (T3) multi-cherry conditional Q6 transfer with an automatic deletion gap. For T1/T3, for every original short matching and cut satisfying the stated assumptions, and every legal source set S of size s>=3 with the stated actual marked B classification, the endpoint extension exists. Quantifiers include covered and free targets and every feasible k, hence k=6,7,8,9. Existence of a suitable cut, suitable S in the exceptional free-target case, local forced-forest structure and higher local certificates are not conclusions. No complete higher Q6 layer, predecessor induction, or full P6 is proved.

Types, dependencies, and hypothesis ledger

M is the original short cube matching; M_A,M_B are its internal restrictions. C is the original crossing matching, X_A,X_B its ports, c its size. A and B are 32-vertex faces, not abstract terminal sets. S consists of original A holes and Y of their mirrors. D is a freely chosen complete-graph matching on the specified free A vertices. P_A is a simple Hamilton path through M_A+D. T is the matching of actual transferred paths with A interiors. L is the B perfect matching after suppression of Y; it is generally neither M_B nor a short matching. K=B minus H_* is L's terminal set. In the local lemma, K has size 2n, R is a partial matching of r pairs, K^- has size 2(n-r), P is the endpoint pairing of a legal short-complement forest, and P^- deletes R. Global R may only be used through the explicitly assumed classification; it is not assumed that such a classification has been certified for every geometry.

Dependency DAG: accepted all-balanced Q5 endpoints -> legal A path for prescribed D -> transferred forest/T -> simultaneous Y suppression/L -> obstruction avoidance -> assumed B cycle classification -> expansion. Independently, universal forced R + selected legal forest rows of full reduced GF(2) rank + generic rank upper bound -> Section 5 classification. Section 5 can supply the classification in the DAG but does not use the Q6 conclusion. The c=0 case uses the declared five-direction endpoint import. There is no dependency on an unproved higher Q6 layer.

The local rank import is valid for arbitrary complete-graph perfect matchings, with every even residual terminal size >=2. The primary accepted manuscript states the GF(2) bound for all even sizes; no bipartite restriction appears. Here it is used at 2(n-r), not merely at the older 22-terminal instance. Required lower rank must be verified in that same field. The selected columns may be a subset: full target rank on that submatrix implies the selected full rows are independent. Together with the generic upper bound this makes them span the whole row space. This is a conditional certificate criterion; no new geometry's certificate is supplied or accepted here.

Proof-obligation audit

  1. Port identity. Internal short matching pairs remove equal even/odd counts, giving |X_A∩E|-|X_A∩O|=b-a-delta. Reducing mod 2 gives c≡a+b+delta. These identities are used with the correct signs in all four completion rows.

  2. Completion/root legality. In the even branch s=a+1-b<=a; sources are even and cannot be the odd target. With root in B, one source is retained as the local free even root. In the odd branch the explicit exclusions remove the free target and the root mirror; with root in B there are s+1 more even than odd A ports, so a free even port root exists. Ports and sources are disjoint. All V_D have even size and omit the local root and any free target. A covered target may become a D endpoint when it is a port, which is allowed by the imported endpoint theorem.

  3. All-balanced endpoint import. The remaining hole counts are exactly (b,b) or (a+1,a+1), including the free even root. Counts are feasible because they arise from an actual matching on 32 vertices. The target remains odd and legal, whether free or covered. Artificial D edges may be arbitrary, so prescribed same-parity crossing-partner pairs do not violate the import. The final A10 acceptance explicitly includes all feasible balanced counts, including the empty-matching endpoint boundary.

  4. Deletion size. With delta=1, d=(c+s)/2>=2. With delta=0, d=(c+s-1)/2>=2; in the odd case c>=s+1 gives d>=s. Parity removes the possible half-integral boundary. These estimates hold independently of k.

  5. Original mirror mates. Every y in Y is internally M_B-covered. Its free mirror excludes crossing coverage; nonroot independence excludes an original opposite-parity hole; parity or the explicit root-mirror exclusion excludes u. The short mates h_y are distinct, have parity opposite Y, and cannot be ports, free root, or Y. Hence the only T/M_B conflicts are the stated pendant conflicts. This step genuinely uses shortness of the original M, not shortness of L.

  6. Tagged transferred forest. For delta=1, P_A+uv is a simple 32-cycle: uv cannot already be an edge of a 32-vertex Hamilton path whose endpoints are u,v. Removing nonempty D gives a forest. For delta=0, a path with distinct B leaves, including the root tag leaf, stays a forest. The root, ports, and mirrors are distinct B endpoints. After attachments every A degree is two; thus compression is a perfect matching T of B endpoints with exactly one tagged edge.

  7. Isolated target port. If a covered target is a port and loses its unique P_A edge, the retained tag and crossing give it degree two. With root in A this is already in the tagged-cycle argument. Suppressing all Y gives L on exactly K, with holes (H∩B) minus {u}, union Y. The stated global parity hole counts follow. The true local input must be applied to this actual L, not to the original M_B.

A nonport endpoint retains an original short edge to the opposite parity; that edge is unaffected since its mate cannot lie in Y. Suppression only moves a Y endpoint to an opposite-parity h_y. An edge to u cannot lie wholly in V(R). Thus every L edge wholly in V(R) is an unchanged T edge between two ports. This argument applies to all edges on a multi-R alternating cycle, including a parallel two-edge cycle.

In the odd branch with root in B, R's B endpoints are even, their A crossing partners are odd, and the chosen port root is even. With root in A it is free u. All prescribed endpoints therefore lie in V_D, disjointly. The remaining vertices can be paired arbitrarily.

From the tagged A cycle, deletion of that edge and at least one other D edge cuts both complementary arcs. Distinct B leaves cannot reconnect components. Hence its B pair is absent from T, and therefore L. This proof quantifies over every local endpoint path delivered for the prescribed D.

A labeled cycle in F+R is then a closed full component of F+P. It omits nonempty K^- because r<n, so it cannot be the whole alternating cycle. A shared F/R pair is a labeled two-edge cycle and is rejected.

Suppressing the internal vertices gives a perfect matching F^-; no loop or unaccounted cycle survives. For every selected P=R union P^-, expansion/contraction preserves connectedness, and both full and reduced unions are 2-regular labeled graphs. This proves the required alternating-cycle equivalence, including residual size two.

Each column F^- has a nonzero entry: cyclically connect its matching edges, with the labeled double-edge convention on two terminals. If every selected row vanished in that column then the whole row space would vanish there, contradiction. Thus one selected forest connects. A physical F/forest edge duplication in the full graph would itself form a proper two-edge component since n>=2; connectivity excludes it. Expansion therefore gives a simple cycle with short edges outside F.

No bound on total |R| is needed beyond the assumed local classification. A bound involving |R| would impose an unnecessary hypothesis.

  16. Multi-cherry lifting. Any L+R cycle alternates and has all vertices in V(R). Obligation 9 confines it to T+J_B. Replace its T edges by their actual internally disjoint A paths and crossing leaves, then replace the J_B joins by J_A and remove the leaf crossings. This produces an actual labeled cycle, not a possibly self-intersecting closed walk. For root in A it lies in (P_A+uv) minus (D minus J_A), a proper edge-deleted simple cycle, hence forest. For root in B a cycle cannot use the tag root leaf; the remaining graph lies in P_A minus (D minus J_A), a subgraph of a path. Both are contradictions.

  17. Expansion and shortness. The B classification now applies to the actual L. Its cycle uses precisely B minus Y. Transferred paths have A interiors; suppressed paths add only Y and their prescribed endpoint mates, so their interiors are disjoint from the B cycle and one another. Expansion gives one tagged spanning 64-cycle containing every original M edge. D edges have disappeared; compressed edges are placeholders that expand. Delete the tag to get the specified Hamilton path with every new surviving edge short.

Free targets with a>=1 exclude at most two and still suffice. With a=0 and two distinct exclusions, only b-2=s-1 remain; independence of Z union W does not forbid this. Full H-independence excludes bar(u) from W, leaving at most one exclusion, as claimed. The main theorem explicitly assumes legal S and does not claim that this exceptional case is automatically solved.
