The assignment explicitly requests this configuration; the proof-checker skill's nominal Astra/ultra configuration was not used. No cross-family review is claimed. Instruction source: F:/c4free-hypercube-main/ARIS/skills/skills-codex/proof-checker/SKILL.md. Only this audit's new files were written; no main proof status was changed.

Exact quantified statement

For every matching F covering exactly the 26 vertices outside {0,1,2,7,13,14} of K(Q5), there exists a simple cycle with vertex set Q5 minus {1,2}, containing every edge of F and having cube distance one for every edge outside F. Original edges may have arbitrary length or parity. Transporting the entire construction gives every cube-automorphic image of this marked configuration, including opposite parity orientation.

The label maps v_A -> 2v+1 and v_B -> 2v are cube isomorphisms on the faces, with equal labels joined by a short edge across the cut. The holes become exactly A:{0,3,6} and B:{0,7,1}, with omissions 0_A and 1_B. The retained original free vertices are globally {0,7,13,14}. Each face has thirteen originally covered vertices, so the crossing count is exactly one of 1,3,5,7,9,11,13.

The only retained foundation imports are the arbitrary-matching Q4 N14 theorem and the exact balanced Q4 tables already audited in T15_BALANCED_BRIDGE_REVIEW.md/.json. I read that audit and the precise N14 statement in Q4_CORE_AND_A4_SPLIT.md. The six relevant source identities (two N14 binaries, the N14 statement, two balanced binaries, and the prior audit Markdown) match their hashes in the prior review. I did not rerun the foundations and do not claim to have done so. The author's small-crossing counts and new combined verification JSON were not accepted as proof by themselves: the core5 finite obligations were recomputed.

Dependency and proof-obligation ledger

There is no circular dependency. The graph is N14 -> connected A boundary pairings; exact balanced tables -> positive compressed B matchings and at most two negatives; elementary pairing obstruction / new B kernels / positive residual certificates -> a valid compressed cycle; disjoint path expansion -> the claimed thirty-cycle. Neither full T15 nor an eight-hole/P6 assertion is an input.

Obligation Independent judgment and discharge
Step 1: artificial matching X_A is disjoint from the original A holes and from internal F_A. Adding z and any perfect matching D yields seven required edges and exactly the two same-parity holes 0 and the other retained A hole (3 or 6). Thus N14 applies for every deliberately selected D.
Step 1: connectedness D is nonempty and is contained in one simple N14 cycle. Removing it gives paths spanning A minus 0; their endpoints are exactly E=X_A union {z}. Compression of the original cycle proves D union R connected as a multigraph. Parallel copies of a shared edge must be retained in this argument.
Step 2: internal mirror B mirror z is internally covered. Its mate k is not a port; the transported partner q of z is a port. Thus k differs from q, and suppressing z gives a genuine six-edge matching L with holes {0,7,1,z}.
Step 2: injectivity In L the edge incident to k identifies q. Undo kq -> kz,zq, remove the other fixed internal edges, and pull ports back through C. Hence at most the two negative bridge6 matchings can produce bad boundary R.
Step 3: occupied mirror d=C inverse(z) is an originally covered A port and differs from A hole z. Prescribe zd in D, replace it by z_A,z_B,d_A, then delete the nonempty D' when c>=3. This is deletion of matching edges from a simple expanded cycle, so no closed forest component survives.
Step 3: quotient The endpoints are the other B ports; internal F_B has disjoint support. Compression gives a perfect matching Q on c-1 endpoints and D' union Q connected. The map Q -> F_B union C(Q) is injective for fixed F_B,C.
Step 4: exclusion lemma On N>=6 vertices an edge of the first forbidden matching is disjoint from some edge of the second: at most two of its at least three edges meet the first edge. Extend these two disjoint edges to D. Each shared edge is an isolated doubled-edge component in D union R_i. All such unions are disconnected because N>2. The zero- and one-forbidden cases also hold.
Step 5: large crossings Internal mirror c>=5 gives N=c+1>=6; occupied mirror c>=7 gives N=c-1>=6. Select D or D' after determining the forbidden pairings. The subsequent N14 output must be connected with the selected artificial matching, so cannot be forbidden. Existential quantifiers are in the correct order.
Step 6: occupied c5 Four internal B edges remain. Every bad L is one of exactly two negatives and decomposes by selecting two of its six edges as Q. Fresh enumeration gives 30 distinct four-edge F_B inputs; each has exactly one bad quotient among its three possible Q. Arbitrary C merely relabels this four-element boundary. Set D'=Q_bad, whose union with itself has two components; N14 then realizes another Q.
Step 7: c3 All 270270 B partial matchings and all six crossing permutations were independently checked. Every one of 1621620 inputs has a bridge permitting at least two of its three pairings. N14 supplies at least two realizable A pairings: a singleton R0 would contradict connectedness on choosing D=R0. Two subsets of size at least two in a three-element set intersect. Occupied-mirror loops are excluded by the B checker.
Step 8: c1 Fresh enumeration covers 13 ports times 10395 internal B matchings. Exactly five inputs have neither bridge admissible, and their complete edges/ports equal the producer's input list. For each remaining input the unique two-endpoint pairing is realized by N14.
Step 9: residual coverage For each of the thirteen possible A ports, pair its other twelve covered vertices exhaustively by taking the least remaining vertex and each possible partner. This is a disjoint exhaustive recursion, giving 10395 matchings per port. Times five B inputs gives exactly 675675 residual original matchings.
Step 9: positive cycles A fresh checker reconstructs every expected required edge, checks exact byte equality with its record, verifies thirty distinct vertices with support exactly Q5 minus {1,2}, removes all thirteen required edges from the cycle-edge set, and checks cube distance one on the remaining seventeen edges. Exact record count and absence of trailing bytes pass.
Final expansion Replace every required compressed matching edge in the balanced fourteen-cycle by its corresponding path. The interiors consist of A minus 0 and B mirror z and are pairwise disjoint, outside the other B vertices. The result is one simple cycle of 14+15+1=30 vertices. Every original edge is retained.
Automorphic orbit A cube automorphism preserves incidence, distinct vertices, holes, omissions, and Hamming distance one. Apply it to both the arbitrary matching and the entire constructed cycle; the exact marked-orbit conclusion follows.
Independent computation

New source: T15_CORE5_FULL_independent_check.cpp. It does not import any producer/checker code, generated negative-list text, or the author's verification JSON. It reads the two audited raw balanced table binaries. Bridge3 uses (3,1) directly; bridge6 is the coordinate image of (3,4) under bit map [1,2,0,3].

The B checker chooses the port subset first and independently pairs the complement. For every crossing permutation and endpoint pairing it builds the compressed multigraph and uses a disjoint-set union structure to find its connected components. The mirror must have degree two and all other active vertices degree one. Each accepted component must have exactly two non-mirror endpoints; components with no such endpoints, including an occupied-mirror loop, are rejected. Compressing these components gives the B matching looked up in the imported exact negative table. This component-based algorithm differs from both the producer's explicit suppression and the supplied verifier's path-tracing implementation.

The residual checker performs no search; it directly verifies the saved positive witness for every independently reconstructed original input. Its checks use explicit failure exits, so they remain active regardless of whether C++ assertions are enabled.

Exact path test (candidate lines 69-83). In a d--z path containing L, the z endpoint must use its sole prescribed incident edge zk. Removing z therefore leaves a spanning d--k path on 14 vertices. Its endpoint edge dk cannot already occur: a path with more than two vertices cannot contain its endpoint-to-endpoint edge. Adding dk closes it. Conversely remove the required dk from a 14-cycle and append the original kz. Even if dk is long, it is removed in expansion; kz is prescribed. There is no unverified shortness assumption. The impossible z=d case is handled explicitly.

Safe forest (lines 93-115). D is a matching contained in a simple path. Its removal makes a path forest. Every nonendpoint port loses its D edge and regains degree one after its original crossing is attached; d gains its crossing; z gains its bridge. If z_A is a port, it loses its final D edge and becomes isolated, then gains two distinct incident edges: its original crossing and the new bridge to the safe B vertex. The B endpoints are distinct because the bridge endpoint is outside X_B. This is still a path, not a lost vertex or a closed component. All resulting interiors are disjoint, which licenses compression and expansion.

Occupied forest (lines 117-132). Here the root is chosen after the actual crossing C is fixed: d=C inverse(z_B). It is required to be good for this z, which means existence of some D for this fixed root. Since c>=3, D is nonempty. Removing even one D edge from the d--z path separates d and z, including the case that the final D edge isolates z. The crossing at d attaches z_B to the d component. The bridge then connects that component to the different z component. It cannot close a cycle. If z_A is another port, its original crossing has a B endpoint different from z_B by injectivity of C. The final forest endpoints are exactly X_B minus {z_B}, with interiors A minus {0} together with z_B. The excluded c=1 case would lack this separation and is not incorrectly passed here.

Hall quantifiers (lines 134-178). If all available z are occupied and no occupied transfer works, actual C gives an injection from available z into A ports, assigning each z a bad root. Rejecting every such injection is stronger than needed and covers every B port set and crossing bijection. A good root need not use one globally common D: after selecting z and its actual root, its own witnessing D can be chosen. Thus no forall/exists exchange is hidden in the good-root argument.

One-crossing cycle switch (lines 180-220). Each individual pair may choose a different common edge and different witnessing path/cycle. Membership in both unions is sufficient: it supplies a witness on each side for that selected edge; spectra need not be maximal. C_A uses A minus {0} and h_B, while C_B uses B minus {x,h}, so their supports are disjoint and total 30. A common optional edge avoids 0,x,h. Deleting one edge from each cycle produces two paths; the two corresponding bridges connect their four distinct endpoints into a single cycle. Neither deleted edge is prescribed, and the sole prescribed crossing d_A h_B survives. The independent checker checks degree two, connectedness, exact support, prescribed-edge containment and new-edge shortness for every pair.

Deterministic results

The standalone checker is t15_single_avoided_face_independent_check.py; its recorded output is t15_single_avoided_face_independent_check.json. Run with Python 3.10 or later from any working directory. Runtime in this run was about 72 seconds.

  • 2,027,025 near-perfect rooted states, forward checked at every applicable odd target: 15,135,120 exact comparisons to Q4 source exception sets.
  • Complete fixed-target failure sets: 105 each for 13,14,31,35,37; zero for 19,32,38. No producer-provided count used in deriving these sets.
  • For each nonempty row, exact stalled partial counts at c=1,3,5,7,9,11: 105,105,21,1,0,0. Every stalled completion was regenerated and rechecked.
  • All 635 c>=3 stalled partials have an independently derived deficient Hall subset; all 105 c=1 stalls for orbit 37 have more usable targets than ports. The other 420 c=1 stalls have exactly their claimed h.
  • 4200 distinct inputs: exactly 105 A and 945 B matchings for each of the four remaining rows. B coverage was checked against all pairings of the exact ten covered vertices; A coverage against fresh failure enumeration.
  • All 34,514 stored positive path/cycle witnesses checked; every stored spectrum equals the reconstructed optional-edge union. Search node and solution-count metadata were not used.

All 396,900 intersections are nonempty. For each pair, a selected witness pair was actually joined and verified as a valid simple 30-cycle. This is an exhaustive deterministic certificate check within the finite claimed domain, not sample evidence for additional T15 geometries.

Counterexample pass and verdict boundary

Adversarial cases examined: d=z; endpoint z carried by D rather than F_A; temporary isolated z_A; the smallest occupied crossing count c=3; the forbidden occupied c=1 closure; a safe target internally covered in B; same-parity/long required edges; repeated/artificial compressed edges; overlap of the two cycles through h_B; optional edge incident to an omitted vertex; a union edge witnessed by different choices on the two sides; and a matching input missing from or duplicated in positive files. The first and occupied c=1 cases are excluded exactly where needed, overlap is avoided by excluding h_B from C_B, and all other boundaries are discharged above. No verified counterexample or open proof obligation remains for the stated claim relative to the explicit Q4 inputs.

This PASS is same-family/provisional semantic review, with deterministic finite verification accepted for the stated input files. It closes the specified eight marked Q5 T15 orbits relative to the imported finite Q4 results. It neither proves full T15/P6 nor changes a Q6 parent count; such coverage must be recomputed over all allowed cuts separately.

本审计未修改主证明、作者脚本、证书、主状态或既有审计。 另写 T44_Q5_CLOSURE_REVIEW_check.py 和对应 _check.json。 本报告与 T44_Q5_CLOSURE_REVIEW.json 是本轮独立审计输出。

完整有限覆盖重新计算

新脚本直接读取两张 Q4 二进制避双孔圈表，不导入作者脚本，也不以其逆像 异常 JSON 作为坏状态的计算依据。对每份文件重新检查全部135135个有效、 互不重复的 mate involution；这一数目恰等于14点完整图的13!!个完美匹配， 故覆盖没有遗漏。所有正圈逐边核验：顶点恰为非避点、原边全在、新边全短。 51和53个负记录另行枚举全部不重叠短补完美匹配，所得318个2-factor 没有一个连通。每个可能扩圈必须由原匹配加这样一个短补匹配构成，故负判定 是穷尽证明。二进制负集合与作者 exception JSON 精确一致。

通过坐标置换把两类坏表传到全部8个奇目标。随后正向遍历全部2027025个 (d,L)：15种根，每根13!!种匹配；对两个目标族分别直接实行 T_z=L−zk+dk，并明确将 z=d 标为不可行。独立得到双目标失败状态 恰256和187个。此步骤不依赖作者“逆像并集穷尽”的计算推理， 同时语义核验了该逆像推理本身：任一失败且z≠d的正向状态都能从负表中 其人工边dk的方向唯一恢复；两个不同目标不可能同时等于d。

对双目标失败状态的所有所需大小子匹配计数。一个c端口局部匹配恰有 c(c−2)!!个不同的带根补全；计数达到该数当且仅当所有补全都双失败。 每一个stalled匹配集合都与作者JSON逐项相等，数量为：

进一步对这些stalled匹配，直接逐根枚举其所有配对D，对每个奇目标计算 实际失败补全数。所有 bad_counts、good_roots 和排除禁点1后的G 与作者JSON逐项精确相等；没有用逆像计数替代本步骤的正向补全验证。 好根含义严格是“对该指定根，存在一个D”，没有将存在根误用成任意根。

注入阻断另用 Hall 子集检验，没有复用作者的回溯注入DFS： 对每个非空S⊆G，计算所有坏根的并N(S)。若某S满足|N(S)|<|S|， 则不存在把每个z分配给坏根的注入。这正是所需的匹配阻断条件。 每个stalled输入或满足|G|>c，或在c≥3时具有这样的Hall缺额； 所有c=1输入均满足|G|>1。两族全部层的unresolved均为0。 因此实际B端口集及实际交叉边伙伴任意取值也被覆盖，而不是有限Q5样例检验。

规范化与几何覆盖

平移一个指定孔为0保短，另一个同奇偶孔的距离只能2或4；置换分别变3或15。 同时切开指定孔对和另一孔对的坐标存在，当且仅当两差分支持相交。 若指定孔距4，另一差分非零且偶重，不能支持在唯一剩余坐标上，所以总有此切分。

距2时，独立枚举其余14个偶点的全部91个无序对，支持不交的恰18对。 保持{0,3}的群由平移0或3、前两坐标置换及后三坐标置换组成。 直接生成三代表(12,20)、(5,9)、(5,29)的群轨道，每轨道6对，彼此不交、 并集精确等于该18对。中间代表在共同坐标面；另外两代表按草稿所述 选择A的奇/偶面、删坐标0并在第一族同时平移局部标签1，确实分别得到 A唯一孔0、B三孔{1,7,11}或{1,2,14}；被禁孔确实为0_A与1_B。 同一局部标签在两面对应短桥。全局孔奇偶相同，而两面局部孔奇偶相反。

两孔各在一面的切分，正交叉用N14_4和片段压缩，零交叉用 Q4_RICH_GLUING.md；全孔同面，正交叉用T44_4及Fink，零交叉用 T44_SAMEFACE_ZERO_CROSSING.md。这两套切分再加上述两个规范族穷尽全部几何。 规范族计数 2|F_A|+c=15 强制c奇且正；B有三孔强制c≤13。

局部路径与拼接的语义审计

令L=F_A∪D有孔0,d，奇z≠d必被L覆盖。k=L(z)，置换边zk到dk后得到 恰有孔0,z的T_z。其14圈删dk后成为d–k路径，再接原边kz，得到 A\0上的15点d–z路径P。反向删除端点z时必删其原L边zk，再闭人工dk， 确实得到所需14圈；长路径两端不可能已经是路径上的另一条端点连边。 故此处可用完整正负表作精确判定，并非仅有充分性。

删D时不能漏掉z本身为A端口的情形：若z∈X_A−{d}，它的L边属于D， 又因z是P端点，该边为唯一P边，删后z暂时孤立。它随即接自己的原交叉边 及新短桥，两条边恢复度2；同样不丢任何F_A边。D与F_A不交。

安全情形z∉X_B，所有附加B端点彼此不同，结果是路径森林，内部精确分割 A\0，端点为X_B∪{z}。孤立的z_A附接后给出一个有效两边路径； 不会产生零长度压缩边或圈。压缩成R后：

  • z=f或g时，F_B∪R只剩两个奇孔，含禁点1，N14_4避1； 15个B点加15个A点，正好30。
  • 其他安全z不等于1、f、g且不为B端口，故内部原边zk存在。 q=R(z)是B端口、k为F_B内点，二者不同。把zk,zq抑制成kq后， 恰四个不同奇孔{1,f,g,z}。T44_4避1,z；展开恢复z_B及其原边， 再恢复15个A点，计14+1+15=30。

占用情形z∈X_B时，选实际原交叉伙伴为d，并为这个根选一个成功D。 可行性保证d≠z；桥不是已存在原交叉边。c≥3保证D非空。 P端点d,z的唯一路径包含每条D边，所以删D后这两个端点属于不同分量； 即便z因删末边变孤立，此事实仍成立。原交叉附接只给各A端口添加不同的 B叶子，不能合并A分量。z_B此时只附着d分量，新桥把它接到另一个z分量， 不会形成圈。若z也是A端口，其原交叉的B端点与z_B不同，因为原交叉伙伴 是一一对应，且d≠z。这一孤点边界因此确实成立。

结果为端点X_B{z}的路径森林，其内部精确分割(A\0)∪{z_B}。 压缩后F_B∪R是合法匹配，其四孔{1,f,g,z}全奇且互异：B端口不可能为 原孔1,f,g。T44_4避1,z，展开恢复z_B、15个A点及所有原交叉边， 再次得到30点简单圈。D已删、R或抑制边已展开，所有存留的非F边来自 Q4证书的短边或新增同标签短桥。原长边始终作为规定边保留。

c=1若使用占用步骤会在A侧形成一个闭分量；草稿明确排除，独立完整计数 证明每个此类stalled输入都有安全端点，故没有以非法边界代替证明。

没有仅凭 q4_perfect_endpoint_abundance_check.json 的 PASS 或4708条记录 假定其分类穷尽。除阅读 Q4_PERFECT_ENDPOINT_ABUNDANCE.md 的等价与逆像论证外， 本次独立核验器还直接执行：

  5. 对这些匹配重新以正向等价计算全部八个奇目标的坏集合， 逐匹配与输入 JSON 比较，精确一致；最大坏端点数为4。

等价的适用条件已检查：若 P(0)=y，任何含该边的0–y路径会只有两个顶点， 故该目标必坏。否则令 a=P(0)、b=P(y)，则0,y,a,b不同， T=P−{0a,yb}+{ab} 恰有孔0,y。所需路径与包含 T 的14点避双孔圈相互转换， 人工 ab 只在中间存在，原匹配边在展开时全部恢复。

因此任何不在逆像候选中的完美匹配，至多有其奇数根伴点这个坏目标， 其余目标都由完整正表认证。候选内最大坏数4，严格推出任意根的至少4个 异奇偶可行端点；完整分类没有遗漏其他可能的多坏目标匹配。

由三个不同单位向量构成的两类集合 {ei,ej,ek}、{ei,ej,ei xor ej xor ek} 共16个。 独立程序直接生成这16个集合，并确认没有一个包含于任一精确异常坏集合。 候选外最多一个坏端点也不可能包含三元集合。故这些 triples 对所有任意完整图 完美匹配确实为 hitting sets，平移给出任意根版本。

语义推理与量词

固定任意 A 中四孔同奇偶匹配 L、B 中任意完美匹配 P，以及指定避孔 x,y。 把 x 平移到0，置换令 y=3或15；四孔变偶，另两孔记 b<t。 同一个 Q4 自同构必须同时作用于两面，使短桥端点对应不变。 P 经变换仍是任意完整图完美匹配，未增加约束。

由完整正路径表，对 L 存在端点集合 S，且或者 |S|≥5， 或者 S xor b 含一个 hitting triple。P 的可行端点集合 G(P,b) 至少4个， 与 S 均位于同一个8点异奇偶类：

  • |S|≥5 时，5+4>8，交集非空；
  • 低集合情形，由平移后的 hitting-triple 定理，同样交集非空。

选交点 q 后，两条路径独立选择：A 路径精确覆盖14个非避点， B 路径覆盖全部16个点；都从对应 b 到对应 q，q 与 b 异奇偶，因而不同。 添加 b–bar(b)、q–bar(q) 两条短桥得到一个圈。 两个端点都在 A 路径内，绝不等于被避开的 x,y。 两个路径的顶点支持在不同面而不交，圈共30点，原匹配边全保留。 没有原交叉边需要恢复，所以新增桥不会与任何原边冲突。

量词为“对每个 L、每个 P，存在 q 和两条路径”， 不需要同一个 q 对所有 P 有效，也未把 S 中所有端点同时处方给一条路径。

If u in A, deleting a nonempty D separates the two true endpoint segments before tagging. If u in B, tagging extends the terminal segment to the previously untouched u. Thus the tagged graph is a forest and compresses to a matching T on B.
  5. There is no Y conflict set because s=0. T and the original internal B matching have disjoint covered endpoints: its ports and B-root were previously free. The complete B matching L has hole counts (k−a−1,k−b+s)=(0,0). Apply the imported arbitrary perfect-matching cycle extension theorem, expand each recorded transferred path, and delete the unique tag. MC6 — nonzero arbitrary columns. Write any F as edges (a_i,b_i) for i=1..N/2. Pair b_i with a_(i+1) cyclically. This is another perfect matching on exactly K, and its union with F is a single alternating cycle. Hence every F column of the full matrix is nonzero, regardless of shortness or parity of its edges.
